title.en: ANTA Sports Reaches New Heights in S&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment — Ranks No. 1 in China's Textiles, Apparel, and Luxury Goods Industry for the First Time, with Full Marks Across Multiple Assessment Areas
title.tc: 安踏體育於標普全球企業可持續發展評估再創高峰 — 首次榮膺中國紡織品行業第一 多個範疇摘滿分
title.sc: 安踏体育于标普全球企业可持续发展评估再创高峰 — 首次荣膺中国纺织品行业第一 多个范畴摘满分

body.en:
Key Highlights:

ANTA Sports scored a record-high 71 in the S&P Global 2026 Corporate Sustainability Assessment (CSA), significantly exceeding the global industry average of 31. The result puts ANTA Sports first in the rankings for China's Textiles, Apparel & Luxury Goods Industry for the first time.

ANTA Sports earned full marks in 41 criteria, spanning multiple dimensions including corporate governance, environmental protection, supply chain management and human rights. The Group also retained its "AA" rating in the MSCI ESG Ratings and remained a constituent of several leading ESG indices.


(Hong Kong SAR, 29 September, 2026) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company"; stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), together with its subsidiaries, the "Group") is pleased to announce that it achieved a score of 71 in the S&P Global 2026 Corporate Sustainability Assessment (CSA), conducted by the international rating agency S&P Global. This record-high score places ANTA Sports No. 1 in China's Textiles, Apparel & Luxury Goods Industry for the first time. The Group's score also significantly exceeded the global industry average of 31.

Full-score Excellence Across Multiple Dimensions
The assessment evaluates companies across three key dimensions: Environmental, Social, and Governance & Economic, covering more than 150 criteria. ANTA Sports achieved full marks in 41 criteria, including:

- Board Diversity Policy
- Anti-Bribery & Anti-Corruption Policy
- Supplier ESG Programs
- Packaging Commitment
- Indirect Greenhouse Gas Emissions (Scope 2)
- Climate Risk Management
- Human Rights Due Diligence Process

ESG Achievements Recognized by Professionals
ANTA Sports has continued to strengthen its commitment to sustainability and drive excellence across all aspects of ESG. Earlier this year, the Group was included in the S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook (China Edition) for the fourth consecutive year. In addition, ANTA Sports maintained an outstanding "AA" rating in the MSCI ESG Ratings and remained a constituent of both the Dow Jones Best-in -Class Emerging Markets Index and the Hang Seng ESG 50 Index. These recognitions reflect the confidence of capital markets and leading professional institutions in the Group's sustainability strategy and execution capabilities.

Management Reaffirms Commitment to Advancement of ESG Strategy
Lai Shixian, Chairman of the Sustainability Committee and Co-CEO of ANTA Sports, said: "We are honored to have reached a new milestone in the S&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment which underscores the Group’s leadership position and benchmark status in the sector. The recognition we have received from leading international institutions in recent years reflects the long-standing commitment of teams across the Group to embedding sustainability into our operations and decision-making processes. As ESG becomes increasingly integral to our brand value and long-term growth, we will remain steadfast in our commitment to environmental and social responsibility, continue to enhance our sustainability strategy, and create resilient, long-term value for all stakeholders."

About the S&P Global CSA
The S&P Global CSA is one of the longest-established and most comprehensive global evaluations of corporate sustainability performance, spanning 62 industries worldwide. The assessment provides a robust, quantitative evaluation of company disclosures and performance across three key dimensions, namely environmental, social, and governance. Its rigorous methodology offers a clear and accurate reflection of corporate sustainability management standards.

– End –

About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991; while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEX in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The mission of the Company is to bring the transcendent sports spirit into everyone's life. ANTA Sports principally engages in R&D, design, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including footwear, apparel and accessories. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE, KOLON SPORT, JACK WOLFSKIN, MAIA ACTIVE, etc., ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports, Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc'teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).

新聞摘要：

安踏體育於標普全球2026年企業可持續發展評估（Corporate Sustainability Assessment，CSA）獲得71分，創下集團最佳紀錄；首次榮膺中國紡織品、服裝和奢侈品品牌公司第一，領先全球同業平均31分。本次評估中集團合計於41個項目獲得滿分，覆蓋企業管治、環境保護、供應鏈及人權等多個維度。集團早前亦獲MSCI ESG「AA」評級，並入選多個權威ESG指數。


（中國香港，2026年9月29日） – 安踏體育用品有限公司（「安踏體育」或「本公司」；股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台）；及其附屬公司統稱「集團」或「本集團」）欣然宣佈，安踏體育於國際評級機構標準普爾全球（下稱「標普全球」）2026年企業可持續發展評估（Corporate Sustainability Assessment，CSA）獲得71分，創下集團最佳紀錄，首次榮膺中國紡織品、服裝和奢侈品品牌公司第一，更大幅拋離全球同業的平均成績31分。

多維度勇摘滿分佳績
評估分為環境、社會以及治理與經濟三大範疇，合共設有超過150個細分項目，其中安踏體育於41個項目獲得滿分，橫跨多個類別，包括：

- 董事會多元政策
- 反賄賂與反貪腐政策
- 供應商ESG計劃
- 包裝承諾
- 間接溫室氣體排放（範圍二）
- 氣候風險管理
- 人權盡職調查程序等

ESG成果屢獲專業認可
在可持續發展領域，安踏體育一直積極增加投入，致力追求卓越。早前，集團已獲標普全球連續四年評為《可持續發展年鑑（中國版）》入選企業，同時廣獲其他國際權威認可，包括在MSCI ESG評級保持卓越的「AA級」水平，並持續入選道瓊斯領先新興市場指數及恒生ESG50指數，體現了資本市場與專業機構對集團可持續發展戰略與執行成果的認可。

管理層承諾精進ESG戰略
安踏體育可持續發展委員會主席及聯席首席執行官賴世賢表示：「安踏體育於ESG領域的評估中再創高峰，彰顯集團在行業中的標桿地位，我們深感榮幸。近年我們榮獲多個國際權威機構認證，有賴集團上下長期投入，將可持續發展由理念轉化為日常營運的決策與行動，讓ESG逐步成為品牌價值的核心。展望未來，安踏體育將堅守對環境與社會的承諾，持續精進可持續發展戰略，為各持份者創造更具韌性的長遠價值。」

關於標普全球CSA
標普全球CSA是歷史最悠久、規模最大的全球性企業可持續發展評估之一，涵蓋62個不同行業的可持續發展評估標準，將企業在環境、社會、治理與經濟等相關議題上的訊息披露和績效表現進行量化評分，從而全面反映企業的可持續發展管理水平。

關於安踏體育用品有限公司
安踏於一九九一年創立，而安踏體育用品有限公司（股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台））在二零零七年於香港交易所主板上市，是著名的全球體育用品公司。本公司的使命是將「超越自我」的體育精神融入每個人的生活。安踏體育主要從事研發、設計、製造、營銷和銷售專業體育用品，包括鞋類、服裝及配飾。透過多元化的品牌組合，包括安踏、FILA、DESCENTE、KOLON SPORT、JACK WOLFSKIN 及MAIA ACTIVE等，安踏體育旨在發掘大眾及高端體育用品市場的潛力。安踏體育亦為Amer Sports, Inc.的最大股東，Amer Sports, Inc.是一個全球的標誌性體育和戶外品牌集團，包括Arc'teryx、Salomon、Wilson、Peak Performance和Atomic，其股票於紐約證券交易所（NYSE：AS）上市。

title.sc: 安踏体育2026上半年收入增长12.9%至435.1亿元 — 居中国首位 整体业绩领先行业

body.en:
(Hong Kong SAR, 26 August, 2026) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company"; stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), together with its subsidiaries, the "Group") today announced its unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (the "period"). During the period, the Group's revenue increased 12.9% year-on-year to RMB43.51 billion during the period.

Financial and Operational Highlights
(All monetary figures are in RMB unless otherwise stated)

  1. Market leadership further strengthened, outperforming both industry and market expectations
    1. The Group's revenue increased 12.9% year-on-year to RMB43.51 billion, further strengthening its position as the market leader in China. Operating profit grew 16.1% year on year to RMB11.76 billion.
    2. Revenue from ANTA segment increased 4.8% year on year to RMB17.77 billion, while operating profit grew 1.2% year-on-year to RMB3.99 billion. Despite intense competition in the broader market, the brand continued to reinforce its position as China's leading sportswear brand.
    3. Revenue from FILA segment increased by 6.1% year-on-year to RMB15.05 billion, while operating profit grew 9.7% year-on-year to RMB4.32 billion, with operating profit margin improving to 28.7%.
    4. Revenue from all other brands delivered strong growth, increasing 44.2% year-on-year to RMB10.69 billion, while operating profit grew 43.9% year-on-year to RMB3.54 billion.

  2. Core profitability indicators exceeded market expectations, with improved shareholder returns, demonstrating healthy business operations
    1. Operational efficiency: The Group's gross profit margin increased by 0.5% points year-on-year to 63.9%. The Group's operating profit margin improved by 0.7% points year-on-year to 27.0%.
    2. Cash flow generation: Free cash flow increased significantly by 54.2% to RMB11.63 billion, and the Group maintained a strong net cash position of approximately RMB39.11 billion.
    3. Profit attributable to shareholders: Excluding any one-off gain related to "investments in associates", profit attributable to shareholders rose 12.9% year-on-year to RMB7.94 billion.
    4. Inventory management: Inventory levels remained healthy.
    5. Dividend: The Group declared a payout ratio of 50.3% (excluding share of "profits or losses of associates" and any one-off gain or loss related to the "investments in associates"), delivering attractive returns to shareholders while maintaining a relatively high payout ratio.

  3. Continued progress in AI innovation, talent development, and social responsibility
    1. Continuous job creation: ANTA Sports' total workforce exceeded 60,000 employees.
    2. Enhanced R&D investment: R&D investment reached approximately RMB1.11 billion. The Group launched the "Lingxi Model" and continued to build its AI tool ecosystem across the value chain, enhancing operational efficiency across design, R&D and the full industry chain.
    3. Deepened sustainability initiatives: The Group was continuously selected for the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Emerging Markets Index and the Hang Seng ESG 50 Index. Its MSCI ESG Rating remained at "AA", maintaining the highest rating among Chinese companies in the industry.

Ding Shizhong, Board Chairman of ANTA Sports, said, "ANTA Sports remains committed to building strong planning and management capabilities to drive the sustained and resilient growth of our multi-brand business, while advancing our global management system, enhancing operational efficiency and risk resilience, and creating long-term value for consumers, shareholders and society. Our multi-brand strategy is not merely a matter of capital operation, it is underpinned by strong management capabilities and a commitment to delivering differentiated value to consumers. Brands are our most important assets, and we will never compromise their long-term development for short-term gains. We remain committed to investing in brand building, product innovation and R&D, while enhancing our operational capabilities and strengthening our global management expertise. I firmly believe that Chinese enterprises are fully capable of managing global brands, and that China's management experience will support our ambition to establish ANTA as a brand for the world."

– End –

About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991; while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEX in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The mission of the Company is to bring the transcendent sports spirit into everyone's life. ANTA Sports principally engages in R&D, design, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including footwear, apparel and accessories. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE, KOLON SPORT, JACK WOLFSKIN, MAIA ACTIVE, etc., ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports, Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc'teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).

（中國香港，2026年8月26日） – 安踏體育用品有限公司（「安踏體育」或「本公司」；股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台）；及其附屬公司統稱「集團」或「本集團」）發佈截至二零二六年六月三十日止六個月（「期內」）之未經審核中期業績。集團期內收入同比增長12.9%至人民幣435.1億元。

財務及營運表現亮點
（以下貨幣單位如無標注，均為人民幣）

  1. 市場領導地位進一步鞏固，業績領先行業，優於市場預期
    1. 集團收入同比增長12.9%到435.1億元，穩踞中國市場行業首位，經營溢利按年提升16.1%至117.6億元。
    2. 安踏分部收入同比增長4.8%至177.7億元，經營溢利同比增長1.2%至39.9億元，在競爭激烈的大眾市場中，依然保持中國品牌的行業領先地位。
    3. FILA分部收入同比增長6.1%至150.5億元，經營溢利同比增長9.7%至43.2億元，經營溢利率提升至28.7%。
    4. 所有其他品牌收入同比高速增長44.2%至106.9億元，經營溢利同比增長43.9%至35.4億元。

  2. 核心盈利指標超市場預期，股東回報提升，企業經營健康
    1. 運營效率：集團毛利率提升0.5個百分點至63.9%，集團經營溢利率提升0.7個百分點至27.0%。
    2. 現金流產出：自由現金流入大幅提升54.2%至116.3億元，集團持有的淨現金維持穩健，約為391.1億元。
    3. 股東應佔溢利：股東應佔溢利（不包括與「聯營公司投資」相關的一次性利得）同比提升12.9%至79.4億元。
    4. 庫存管理：庫存保持健康水平。
    5. 派息：派息率50.3% (不包括分佔「聯營公司損益」及任何與「聯營公司投資」相關的一次性利得╱虧損)，給股東有價值的回報，保持較高的派息水平。

  3. AI創新、員工發展、社會責任等領域持續發力
    1. 持續創造就業：安踏體育全球員工總數六萬多名。
    2. 加大創新研發：研發投入約11.1億元，發佈全新的「靈犀大模型」，持續打造覆蓋全價值鏈的AI工具矩陣，提升設計研發及全產業鏈的運營效率。
    3. 深化可持續實踐：持續入選道瓊斯領先新興市場指數及恒生ESG 50指數，在國際權威指數機構MSCI ESG評級中保持AA級，維持中國行業最高評級。

安踏體育董事會主席丁世忠表示：「安踏體育堅持構建『強規劃和強管理』的能力，為多品牌業務的持續穩健增長提供強勁動力，致力搭建全球化管理體系，不斷提升運營效率與抗風險能力，為消費者、股東和社會創造長期價值。多品牌戰略決不是資本運作，而是依託多品牌的管理能力，持續創造差異化的消費者價值。品牌是安踏體育最重要的資產，我們決不為短期利益而透支品牌未來。近年來，我們加大品牌建設的長期投入、商品創新和科技研發，持續提升運營能力和集團賦能多品牌的商業模式，不斷提煉和總結集團多品牌和全球化管理的方法論。我相信，中國的企業完全有能力管理好全球的品牌，中國的管理經驗也一定會支撐『世界的安踏』逐夢踏實、走向全球。」

關於安踏體育用品有限公司
安踏於一九九一年創立，而安踏體育用品有限公司（股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台））在二零零七年於香港交易所主板上市，是著名的全球體育用品公司。本公司的使命是將「超越自我」的體育精神融入每個人的生活。安踏體育主要從事研發、設計、製造、營銷和銷售專業體育用品，包括鞋類、服裝及配飾。透過多元化的品牌組合，包括安踏、FILA、DESCENTE、KOLON SPORT、JACK WOLFSKIN 及MAIA ACTIVE等，安踏體育旨在發掘大眾及高端體育用品市場的潛力。安踏體育亦為Amer Sports, Inc.的最大股東，Amer Sports, Inc.是一個全球的標誌性體育和戶外品牌集團，包括Arc'teryx、Salomon、Wilson、Peak Performance和Atomic，其股票於紐約證券交易所（NYSE：AS）上市。

body.en:
(Hong Kong SAR, 1 June, 2026) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries, collectively the "Group") is pleased to announce that it has been selected, for the fourth consecutive year, for inclusion in the S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook (China Edition), published by international rating agency S&P Global. This recognition reflects the Group's sustained commitment to sustainable development, supported by continuous progress and long‑term investment across its operations.

According to the latest S&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment (CSA) results, ANTA Sports achieved a score of 67 this year, representing a 24% year‑on‑year increase. The Company was rated as the top 5% among the Chinese companies assessed in 2025 and retains its number one position within China’s sportswear industry. This performance underscores ANTA Sports' leadership in sustainability governance, management, and implementation.

Meanwhile, the Group delivered strong performance at the Hong Kong Quality Assurance Agency's Hong Kong Green and Sustainability Contribution Awards 2026, receiving the "Outstanding Pioneer Award Excellence for ESG Disclosure Contribution". The recognition underscores the Group's high level of transparency and its continued enhancement of ESG reporting and disclosure practices, reflecting industry-leading standards.


ANTA Sports was rated as the top 5% among the Chinese companies assessed in S&P Global CSA 2025 and retains its number one position within the industry.


ANTA Sports received the Outstanding Pioneer Award Excellence for ESG Disclosure Contribution from the Hong Kong Quality Assurance Agency

Lai Shixian, Chairman of the Sustainability Committee and Co-CEO of ANTA Sports, said: "We are honored to be included in the S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook (China Edition) for the fourth consecutive year. We are also encouraged by the Hong Kong Quality Assurance Agency's recognition of our ESG disclosure standards. Acknowledgement from multiple professional institutions not only reflects our continued progress in sustainability management, but also reaffirms our long‑term commitment to embedding environmental, social, and governance principles at the core of our corporate strategy. Looking ahead, we will continue to strengthen our performance across all aspects of sustainability, set benchmarks for the industry, and create long‑term value for our stakeholders." 

The S&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment is one of the longest-established and most comprehensive global evaluations of corporate sustainability performance, spanning 62 industries worldwide. The assessment provides a robust, quantitative evaluation of company disclosures and performance across three key dimensions, namely environmental, social, and governance. Its rigorous methodology offers a clear and accurate reflection of corporate sustainability management standards.

The S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook (China Edition) recognizes Chinese companies that demonstrate strong sustainability performance within their respective industries. This year's assessment covered nearly 1,800 companies, with only those ranking within the top 15% of their industry peers eligible for inclusion. A total of around 190 companies were selected, underscoring both the selectivity and credibility of the evaluation process.

The Hong Kong Green and Sustainability Contribution Awards, organized by the Hong Kong Quality Assurance Agency, recognize organizations for their commitment and contributions to advancing the ESG ecosystem, supporting the transition to a low‑carbon economy, and enhancing sustainability disclosure. Among the categories, the "Outstanding Pioneer Award Excellence for ESG Disclosure Contribution" honors companies that actively align with both local and international climate-related disclosure standards and frameworks, continuously strengthen ESG and climate risk management, and enhance the transparency and quality of related disclosures.

–End–

About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991; while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEx in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The mission of the Company is to bring the transcendent sports spirit into everyone’s life. ANTA Sports principally engages in R&D, design, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including footwear, apparel and accessories. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE, KOLON SPORT, MAIA ACTIVE and JACK WOLFSKIN, etc., ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports, Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc’teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).

（二零二六年六月一日──中國香港）安踏體育用品有限公司（「安踏體育」或「本公司」；股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台）；及其附屬公司統稱「本集團」）欣然宣佈，集團連續四年獲國際權威評級機構標準普爾全球（下稱「標普全球」）評為《可持續發展年鑑（中國版）》入選企業，充分體現集團在可持續發展領域的長期投入與持續進步。

根據標普全球最新公佈之企業可持續發展評估（CSA）結果，安踏體育今年獲得 67 分，較去年上升24%，獲評為中國企業標普全球 CSA 2025評分最佳5%，穩居中國體育用品行業第一，再次彰顯集團在可持續發展管理與實踐方面的領先地位。

同時，集團亦於香港品質保證局「香港綠色和可持續貢獻大獎2026」創下佳績，榮獲「傑出ESG披露貢獻先鋒卓越（優進）大獎」，反映集團在ESG報告及訊息披露方面的高透明度並持續優化，展現領先業界的水平。


安踏體育獲評為中國企業標普全球CSA 2025評分最佳5%，穩居行業第一。


安踏體育獲香港品質保證局頒發「傑出ESG披露貢獻先鋒卓越（優進）大獎」。

安踏體育可持續發展委員會主席及聯席首席執行官賴世賢表示：「我們很榮幸安踏體育能夠連續四年入選標普全球《可持續發展年鑑（中國版）》，而香港品質保證局對我們ESG披露水平的高度評價也讓我們深受鼓舞。來自多個專業機構的肯定不僅反映集團在可持續發展管理上持續精進，亦印證我們將環境、社會及管治理念深度融入企業發展戰略的長期承諾。未來，安踏體育將繼續在可持續發展上提升各領域的表現，為行業樹立標竿，並為所有持份者創造長遠價值。」

標普全球企業可持續發展評估（CSA）是歷史最為悠久、規模最大的全球性企業可持續發展評估之一，涵蓋62個不同行業的可持續發展評估標準，將企業在環境、社會、治理與經濟等相關議題上的訊息披露和績效表現進行量化評分，從而全面反映企業的可持續發展管理水平。

標準普爾全球《可持續發展年鑑（中國版）》旨在表彰在各行業中展現出可持續發展優勢的中國企業。今年，年鑑涵蓋近1,800家企業，僅有標普可持續發展評分在同行業中排名前15%的公司才被納入考量；大會最終精選出190餘家評分最佳的公司入選年鑒，足見評選過程相當嚴謹。

(Hong Kong SAR, 25 March 2026) – ANTA Sports Products Limited (“ANTA Sports” or the “Company”; stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), together with its subsidiaries, the “Group”) today announced its audited annual results for the year ended 31 December 2025 (the “financial year”).

Financial and Operational Highlights
(All monetary figures are in RMB unless otherwise stated)

  1. Market leadership further strengthened, with revenue and market share reaching record highs and overall performance exceeding market expectations
    1. The Group’s revenue reached a record high of RMB80.22 billion, increasing by 13.3% year on year, firmly maintaining its leading position in the Chinese sportswear market. Operating profit increased by 15.0% year on year to RMB19.09 billion.
    2. According to data from an internationally recognized institution, ANTA Sports continued to gain market share in China’s sportswear market, with an estimated share of approximately 21.8%, maintaining its position as the industry leader. Globally, the Group also ranked among the top three in the industry.
    3. ANTA’s segment revenue rose by 3.7% year on year to RMB34.75 billion, while operating profit increased by 2.5% to RMB7.21 billion. The business continued to deliver steady progress, maintaining its position as the leading Chinese sportswear brand.
    4. FILA’s segment revenue increased by 6.9% year on year to RMB28.47 billion, while operating profit rose by 10.1% to RMB7.42 billion. Despite being a sizable business, FILA continued to outperform the broader industry, reinforcing its market leading position in the high-end sports fashion segment.
    5. Revenue of all other brands increased significantly by 59.2% year on year to RMB17.00 billion, while operating profit increased by 55.3% to RMB4.74 billion, maintaining strong growth momentum. Among all other brands, DESCENTE’s retail sales surpassed RMB10 billion for the first time in 2025, making it the Group’s third brand to reach this milestone.

  2. Core profitability indicators surpassed market expectations, indicating healthy business operations
    1. Operational efficiency: The Group’s operating profit margin increased by 0.4% points year on year to 23.8%, underscoring its solid operational resilience.
    2. Cash flow generation: Free cash flow amounted to RMB16.11 billion. As at the end of 2025, the Group maintained a solid net cash position of approximately RMB 31.72 billion.
    3. Profit attributable to shareholders: Excluding gain arising from equity dilution related to the Amer Sports listing and placing in 2024, profit increased by 13.9% to RMB 13.59 billion.

  3. Breakthrough achievements across brand value, technological innovation, talent development and social responsibility
    1. Sustained employment growth: The Group’s total workforce exceeded 69,100, including the recruitment of 1,000 university graduates, and supported the creation of nearly 300,000 direct and indirect job opportunities. Investment in employee welfare and training continued to increase.
    2. Enhanced R&D investment: R&D expenditure rose to approximately RMB 2.2 billion in 2025. During the financial year, the Group launched its AI365 Strategy, establishing a range of AI tools across the entire value chain and significantly enhancing design and R&D efficiency.
    3. Brand value enhancement: Ranked among the Top 10 apparel brands in the Kantar BrandZ Most Valuable Global Brands 2025 rankings.
    4. Deepened sustainability initiatives: The Group achieved its first inclusion in the Hang Seng ESG 50 Index, placing it among the top 50 Hong Kong-listed companies for ESG performance. Its MSCI ESG rating was upgraded by four levels over three consecutive years to “AA”.
    5. Increased charitable contributions: Total charitable donations by the Group and the Hemin Foundation exceeded RMB 800 million in 2025, bringing cumulative donations to more than RMB 3.5 billion

Ding Shizhong, Executive Director and Board Chairman of ANTA Sports, said: “In 2025, amid a complex and rapidly changing environment, we once again delivered resilient growth by staying true to our ‘Single-focus, Multi‑brand, Globalization’ strategy. The Group’s revenue surpassed RMB80 billion for the first time, reinforcing a competitive advantage built on a ‘multi‑brand portfolio and strong operational capabilities’. Each of our brands delivered differentiated, high‑quality growth. Growth is the best corporate culture, but it is not about simple expansion of scale. It is about “winning through products and winning through operations”. We have stayed disciplined in our strategy, avoiding short‑term volatility and focusing instead on enhancing operational quality and the long‑term value of our brands. At its core, the multi‑brand strategy reflects a long‑term commitment to understanding evolving consumer needs. ‘Great acquisition, great management and great operation’ underpins the sharpening of brand positioning and the development of sustainable growth models. The Group’s distinctive ‘Brand + Retail’ business model refined over many years, together with our three core competencies in multi-brand management, multi-brand retail operations, and global resource deployment, enables each brand to fully unlock its potential and generate sustained momentum across cycles. This year marks the 35th anniversary of ANTA Sports. Having navigated multiple industry fluctuations and consumption cycles, we are confident that, with a steadfast strategy, we will continue building resilience, health and vitality by driving technological innovation, staying anchored in the China market, and expanding globally to compete on the world stage.” 

– End –

About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991; while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEX in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The mission of the Company is to bring the transcendent sports spirit into everyone’s life. ANTA Sports principally engages in R&D, design, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including footwear, apparel and accessories. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE, KOLON SPORT, JACK WOLFSKIN , MAIA ACTIVE, etc., ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports, Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc’teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).

（中國香港，2026年3月25日） – 安踏體育用品有限公司（「安踏體育」或「本公司」；股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台）；及其附屬公司統稱「集團」或「本集團」）公佈本集團截至二零二五年十二月三十一日止年度（「本財政年度」）之經審核全年業績。

財務及營運表現亮點
（以下貨幣單位如無標注，均為人民幣）

  1. 市場領導地位進一步強化，收入和市場份額再創新高，整體業績高於市場預期
    1. 本集團收入再創歷史新高，按年增長13.3%到802.19億元，穩居中國市場行業首位，本集團經營利潤同比提升15.0%至190.91億元。
    2. 據國際權威機構統計，安踏體育在中國運動鞋服市場份額持續提升，市佔率約為21.8%，保持全行業領先；全球範圍內亦穩居行業前三。
    3. 安踏分部收入按年增長3.7%到347.54億元，經營利潤按年增長2.5%至72.11億元，穩中有進，繼續保持中國運動品牌領導地位。
    4. FILA分部收入按年增長6.9%到284.69億元，經營利潤按年增長10.1%至74.18億元，大體量基礎上依然實現增速跑贏行業，凸顯品牌在高端運動時尚領域的領導地位。
    5. 所有其他品牌收入按年大增59.2%到169.96億元，經營利潤按年增長55.3%至47.36億元，繼續保持高速增長；其中DESCENTE 2025年流水首次突破100億元，成為本集團第三個百億級品牌。

  2. 核心盈利指標超市場預期，企業經營健康
    1. 運營效率：本集團經營溢利率按年上升0.4個百分點至23.8%，展現了扎實的經營韌性。
    2. 現金流產出：自由現金流入161.06億元；截至2025年底，本集團持有的淨現金約為317.19億元。
    3. 股東應佔溢利：撇除2024年Amer Sports上市及配售事項權益攤薄所致的利得後，股東應佔溢利按年增加13.9%至135.9億元。

  3. 全球品牌價值、科技創新、員工發展、社會責任等維度全面突破
    1. 持續創造就業：集團全球員工總數超69,100名，其中吸納超1,000名高校畢業生，創造直接和間接就業崗位近30萬個。持續加大員工福利及培訓投入。
    2. 持續加強創新研發：加大年度研發投入至約22億元，啟動「AI365戰略」，持續打造覆蓋全價值鏈的AI工具矩陣，大幅提升設計研發效率。
    3. 提升品牌價值：登上BrandZ 2025最具價值全球品牌服飾類TOP10。
    4. 深化可持續實踐：首次入選恒生ESG 50指數，躋身香港上市公司ESG表現最佳的50家企業之列；在國際權威指數機構MSCI ESG評級中三年連升四級，達到AA級。
    5. 持續加大公益捐贈：本集團及和敏基金會全年公益捐贈超8億元，累計捐贈超過35億元。

安踏體育執行董事、董事會主席丁世忠表示：「2025年，我們在複雜多變的環境中再次實現了在『單聚焦、多品牌、全球化』戰略引領下的韌性增長。集團收入首次突破人民幣800億元，形成『多品牌、強運營』的絕對優勢，各品牌的差異化實現了高質量增長。增長是最好的企業文化，但不是簡單的規模擴張，而是要『贏在商品、贏在經營』。我們始終堅持戰略定力，不追逐短期波動，專注提升經營品質和品牌的長期價值。多品牌戰略本質上是對消費者需求變化的長期佈局，『買得好、管得好、經營好』是我們夯實每個品牌定位、構建品牌增長模型的基礎。本集團多年沉澱的『品牌+零售』獨特商業模式以及在品牌、零售及全球資源整合的三大核心能力，讓每個品牌充分釋放潛力，獲得穿越週期的持續動力。今年是安踏體育成立的35周年，我們穿越了多輪行業起伏與消費週期的變化，我們有信心未來以堅定的戰略，保持韌性、健康與活力，以科技創新築牢根基，以中國市場為核心走向世界、參與國際競爭。」

body.en:
(Hong Kong SAR, 24 February, 2026) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries, collectively the "Group") is pleased to announce its inaugural inclusion in the Sustainability Yearbook 2026, published by international rating agency S&P Global. This recognition underscores the Group's long-standing commitment to sustainability, the strength of its governance and management practices, and its continued leadership within the industry. 
 
According to S&P Global's latest assessment, ANTA Sports achieved a Corporate Sustainability Assessment (CSA) score of 67, representing a 24% increase compared with the previous year. Out of over 9,200 companies assessed globally, only 848 were selected for inclusion in the Sustainability Yearbook. Among approximately 160 global companies in the Textiles, Apparel & Luxury Goods industry, ANTA Sports ranked ahead of 94% of its peers, solidifying its position as the leading company in China's sporting goods industry.

Lai Shixian, Chairman of the Sustainability Committee and Co-CEO of ANTA Sports, said: "We are honored and proud to be included in the S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook for the first time. This achievement reflects the effectiveness of our long-term ESG initiatives and reinforces our position as a leader in advancing sustainability across the industry. This consistently outstanding performance has led to our inclusion in the Dow Jones Sustainability Emerging Markets Index starting in 2024. Guided by our long-term vision to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050, we continue to strengthen our efforts in supply chain management, carbon reduction, and resource stewardship. Sustainability will remain a core pillar of our corporate strategy as we strive to create long term value for our shareholders and all stakeholders." 

The S&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment is one of the longest-established and most comprehensive global evaluations of corporate sustainability performance, covering 62 industries worldwide. The CSA provides a quantitative assessment of companies' disclosures and performance across three key dimensions, namely environmental, social, and governance. Its rigorous methodology offers a clear and accurate reflection of corporate sustainability management standards.

S&P Global has released the 22nd edition of the Sustainability Yearbook, which recognizes companies demonstrating strong sustainability performance across a wide range of industries. This year's edition assessed approximately 9,200 companies, with only those ranking within the top 15% of their industry peers, based on the S&P ESG Score, eligible for inclusion. In total, 848 companies were selected, including only 13 from the Textiles, Apparel & Luxury Goods industry, underscoring the rigor of the evaluation and selection process.

–End–

About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991; while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEx in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The mission of the Company is to bring the transcendent sports spirit into everyone’s life. ANTA Sports principally engages in R&D, design, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including footwear, apparel and accessories. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE, KOLON SPORT, MAIA ACTIVE and JACK WOLFSKIN, etc., ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports, Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc’teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).

（二零二六年二月二十四日──中國香港）安踏體育用品有限公司（「安踏體育」或「本公司」；股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台）；及其附屬公司統稱「本集團」）欣然宣佈，安踏體育首次入選國際評級機構標準普爾全球（下稱「標普全球」）《可持續發展年鑑2026》，充分彰顯本集團在可持續發展領域的長期投入、管理成效及行業標竿地位。 

根據標普全球最新公佈結果，安踏體育在企業可持續發展評估（CSA）獲得67分，按年上升24%。全球超過9,200家企業中只有 848 家公司成功入選《可持續發展年鑑》，安踏體育在約160家全球紡織品、服裝和奢侈品品牌公司中，排名領先94%的同業，持續穩居中國體育用品行業第一。

安踏體育可持續發展委員會主席及聯席首席執行官賴世賢表示：「我們對安踏體育首次入選標普全球《可持續發展年鑑》感到榮幸和驕傲。此殊榮不僅彰顯安踏體育在ESG領域的長期實踐成果，更印證我們在推動行業可持續發展方面所發揮的引領作用。此成績持續優異，使我們自二零二四年開始被納入道瓊斯可持續發展新興市場指數。我們始終堅持以二零五零年實現碳中和為長期願景，並以實際行動持續推動集團在供應鏈管理、碳中和及資源管理等領域取得突破，全面推進可持續發展戰略。未來，安踏體育將堅持以可持續發展視為企業核心戰略，為股東及所有持份者創造長期價值。」 

標普全球企業可持續發展評估（CSA）是歷史最悠久、最大規模的全球性企業可持續發展評估之一，涵蓋了62個不同行業的可持續發展評估標準，將企業在環境、社會、治理與經濟等三大維度下的各項相關議題的信息披露和績效表現進行量化評分，從而全面反映企業的可持續發展管理水準。

標普全球發表的第二十二屆《可持續發展年鑑》，旨在表彰各行業中展現出可持續發展優勢的企業。今年年鑑涵蓋超過9,200家企業，僅有可持續發展評分在同行業中排名前15%的公司才被考慮納入。今年，大會共精選出848家評分最佳的公司入選年鑒，其中紡織品、服裝和奢侈品行業企業中僅13家公司入選，足見評選過程的嚴謹程度。

–完–

（二零二六年二月二十四日──中国香港）安踏体育用品有限公司（「安踏体育」或「本公司」；股份代号：2020（港币柜台）及82020（人民币柜台）；及其附属公司统称「本集团」）欣然宣布，安踏体育首次入选国际评级机构标准普尔全球（下称「标普全球」）《可持续发展年鉴2026》，充分彰显本集团在可持续发展领域的长期投入、管理成效及行业标竿地位。 

根据标普全球最新公布结果，安踏体育在企业可持续发展评估（CSA）获得67分，按年上升24%。全球超过9,200家企业中只有 848 家公司成功入选《可持续发展年鉴》，安踏体育在约160家全球纺织品、服装和奢侈品品牌公司中，排名领先94%的同业，持续稳居中国体育用品行业第一。

安踏体育可持续发展委员会主席及联席首席执行官赖世贤表示：「我们对安踏体育首次入选标普全球《可持续发展年鉴》感到荣幸和骄傲。此殊荣不仅彰显安踏体育在ESG领域的长期实践成果，更印证我们在推动行业可持续发展方面所发挥的引领作用。此成绩持续优异，使我们自二零二四年开始被纳入道琼斯可持续发展新兴市场指数。我们始终坚持以二零五零年实现碳中和为长期愿景，并以实际行动持续推动集团在供应链管理、碳中和及资源管理等领域取得突破，全面推进可持续发展战略。未来，安踏体育将坚持以可持续发展视为企业核心战略，为股东及所有持份者创造长期价值。」 

标普全球企业可持续发展评估（CSA）是历史最悠久、最大规模的全球性企业可持续发展评估之一，涵盖了62个不同行业的可持续发展评估标准，将企业在环境、社会、治理与经济等三大维度下的各项相关议题的信息披露和绩效表现进行量化评分，从而全面反映企业的可持续发展管理水准。

标普全球发表的第二十二届《可持续发展年鉴》，旨在表彰各行业中展现出可持续发展优势的企业。今年年鉴涵盖超过9,200家企业，仅有可持续发展评分在同行业中排名前15%的公司才被考虑纳入。今年，大会共精选出848家评分最佳的公司入选年鉴，其中纺织品、服装和奢侈品行业企业中仅13家公司入选，足见评选过程的严谨程度。

–完–

title.en: ANTA Sports to Acquire 29% Stake in PUMA, Further Strengthening Globalization Strategy
title.tc: 安踏集團宣佈收購彪馬29%的股權 進一步強化全球化戰略佈局
title.sc: 安踏集团宣布收购彪马29%的股权 进一步强化全球化战略布局

body.en:
• Accelerates multi-brand globalization strategy and enhances ANTA’s global reach and competitiveness
• Brings proven growth track record to help unlock PUMA’s potential globally including in China
• Supports PUMA’s management, strategy, brand autonomy and identity
• Has no current plans to make a takeover offer for PUMA

Hong Kong, 27 January 2026 – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries collectively the "Group"), today announced it has reached a share purchase agreement with Groupe Artémis, the investment company of the Pinault family, to acquire a 29.06% stake in PUMA SE, the company behind iconic global sports brand PUMA. The stake is valued at EUR 1.5 billion in cash. The transaction marks a significant step in ANTA Sports’ globalization strategy, further enhancing its reach, recognition and competitiveness in the global sporting goods market. 

The transaction is expected to close by the end of 2026, subject to relevant regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions. The equity acquisition will be entirely financed with ANTA Sports’ internal cash resources.

Ding Shizhong, Board Chairman of ANTA Sports, commented: “This acquisition makes ANTA Sports the largest shareholder of PUMA and marks a major step forward in our ‘single-focus, multi-brand, globalization’ strategy. PUMA is an iconic global brand with substantial heritage. Working with PUMA, we look forward to learning from each other and joining hands to fully unlock the brand’s full potential. This will further accelerate ANTA Sports’ globalization, and help drive the next chapter of growth for the global sports markets including China – creating lasting value for both companies’ consumers and shareholders worldwide.”

ANTA Sports has over 35 years of experience in the sporting goods industry. Building on its foundation and growth engine in the Chinese market, it has achieved an industry-leading position in the country. The Group has been expanding operations across key markets including Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Africa, North America, and Europe. It has successfully empowered multiple international brands, accumulating extensive experience in multi-brand operations management and brand value revitalization, including its unique “Brand + Retail” business model with a proven track record.

PUMA is globally renowned for its rich heritage and has built deep brand equity and worldwide presence. It also brings powerful sports assets – particularly in football, running, training, basketball, and motorsport, and has a wide reach across key sports markets including Europe, Latin America, Africa, and India. Anta Sports’ portfolio brands and PUMA offer highly complementary strengths across product portfolio, category specialization and regional footprint.

Commenting on the strategic rationale of the transaction, Mr. Ding emphasized: “ANTA has always admired PUMA’s long-term brand value and potential. Such strong brand DNA and value heritage are rare to come by. We believe PUMA’s share price over the past few months does not fully reflect the long-term potential of the brand. We have confidence in its management team and strategic transformation. Moving forward, we hope to build strong trust, work together at arm’s length, and leverage our complementary strengths without comprising independence. We look forward to supporting the brand's ongoing revival.”

ANTA Sports fully appreciates PUMA’s management culture and independent governance as a German-listed company. ANTA Sports intends to seek adequate representation on PUMA’s Supervisory Board. These representatives will work closely with the other Supervisory Board members from both the shareholders’ and employee representatives’ side, while preserving PUMA’s strong brand identity and heritage. The Group will carefully assess the possibility of further deepening the partnership between the two parties in the future. The Group currently has no plans to make a takeover offer for PUMA. 

About ANTA
ANTA was established in 1991; while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEx in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The mission of the Company is to bring the transcendent sports spirit into everyone’s life. ANTA Sports principally engages in R&D, design, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including footwear, apparel and accessories. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE, KOLON SPORT, MAIA ACTIVE and JACK WOLFSKIN, etc., ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports, Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc’teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).

Official website: http://ir.anta.com 

About PUMA
PUMA is one of the world’s leading sports brands, designing, developing, selling and marketing footwear, apparel and accessories. For more than 75 years, PUMA has relentlessly pushed sport and culture forward by creating fast products for the world’s fastest athletes. PUMA offers performance and sport-inspired lifestyle products in categories such as Football, Running and Training, Basketball, Golf, and Motorsports. It collaborates with renowned designers and brands to bring sport influences into street culture and fashion. The PUMA Group owns the brands PUMA, Cobra Golf and stichd. The company distributes its products in more than 120 countries, employs about 20,000 people worldwide, and is headquartered in Herzogenaurach/Germany.

body.tc:
• 加速多品牌全球化戰略，提升全球影響力及競爭力
• 分享成熟的增長經驗，助力彪馬釋放在全球包括中國在內的潛力
• 支援彪馬的管理團隊、戰略規劃、品牌自主權
• 目前沒有對彪馬發起要約收購的計畫

【2026 年1 月27 日，中國香港訊】中國第一大運動品牌、全球領先的多品牌體育用品集團安踏體育用品有限公司（股份代號：港幣櫃檯2020.HK、人民幣櫃檯82020.HK及其附屬公司統稱「安踏集團」或「集團」）今日宣布，與Pinault 家族的投資公司Groupe Artémis 達成協議，收購全球標誌性運動品牌彪馬（PUMA）所屬公司PUMASE 29.06%的股權。現金對價15 億歐元。此舉是安踏集團深入推動全球化策略的重要一步，將提升其在全球運動用品市場的影響力、知名度以及競爭力。

本次交易預計預計於2026年底前完成，但仍需得到相關監管部門批准及滿足慣例交割條件。此次股權收購資金全部來自安踏集團的內部自有現金儲備。

安踏集團董事局主席丁世忠表示：「收購彪馬的股權成為最大股東，是安踏集團深入推廣『單聚焦、多品牌、全球化』發展策略的重要里程碑。彪馬是具有標誌性意義的全球知名品牌，有著深厚的品牌資產。我們期待與彪馬公司相互學習並分享經驗，攜手合作充分釋放其品牌勢能。」

安踏集團深耕體育用品產業35年，以中國市場為根基及發展引擎，獲得在中國市場的全產業領先，並在東南亞、中東、非洲、北美及歐洲等多個關鍵市場拓展業務。集團成功經營多個國際品牌，在多品牌營運管理和重塑多品牌價值方面積累了廣泛且豐富的經驗，包括多年市場驗證的「品牌+零售」的獨特商業模式。

彪馬品牌以其強大的歷史傳承聞名於世，擁有深厚的品牌資產、全球影響力及體育資源，尤其體現在足球、跑步、綜合訓練、籃球和賽車等運動細分品類，在歐洲、拉丁美洲、非洲和印度等關鍵體育市場均有強大的影響力。安踏集團旗下各品牌和彪馬正好在產品組合、專業細分和區域佈置上高度互補。

對於此交易的策略考量，丁世忠強調：「安踏一直看重彪馬這一品牌所蘊含的長期價值與潛力。好的品牌基因與價值沉澱可遇不可求，我們相信彪馬過去幾個月的股價並未充分反映其品牌所蘊含的長期價值。我們對其現在的管理團隊和戰略轉型有信心，未來雙方建立深厚信任，在高度共識的領域開展協作、優勢互補，同時保持各自業務運營上的獨立性、紀律性和戰略清晰，為該品牌的複興之路提供有益的支持。

安踏集團充分尊重彪馬的管理文化，以及彪馬作為德國上市公司的獨立治理架構。交易完成後，安踏體育擬尋求向監事會委派合適的代表，後者將與其他監事會成員及員工代表密切協作，同時致力於保持彪馬深厚的品牌身份與基因。集團未來將審慎評估雙方是否有進一步深化合作關係的可能性。集團目前沒有對彪馬發起要約收購的計畫。


關於安踏集團
安踏於一九九一年創立，而安踏體育用品有限公司（股份代號：2020（港幣櫃檯）及82020（人民幣櫃檯）及其附屬公司統稱“安踏集團”或“集團”）在二零零七年於香港交易所主機板上市，是著名的全球體育用品公司。公司願景是成為世界領先的多品牌體育用品集團。公司使命是將「超越自我」的體育精神融入每個人的生活。安踏集團主要從事研發、設計、製造、行銷和銷售專業體育用品，包括鞋類、服裝及配飾。透過多元化的品牌組合，包括安踏、FILA、DESCENTE、KOLON SPORT、MAIA ACTIVE及JACK WOLFSKIN等，集團旨在發掘大眾及高端體育用品市場的潛力。安踏集團亦為Amer Sports, Inc.的最大股東，Amer Sports, Inc.是一個全球的標誌性體育和戶外品牌集團，包括Arc'teryx、Salomon、Wilson、Peak Performance和Atomic，其股票於紐約證券交易所（NYSE：AS）上市。

關於彪馬（PUMA）
躋身全球一流運動品牌之列的PUMA致力於設計、開發、銷售並行銷各種鞋類、服飾以及配件產品。超過75年來，PUMA積極為全球身手最迅捷的運動健將打造打破速度紀錄的產品，推動運動和文化的發展，從未懈怠。PUMA生產足球、跑步和訓練、籃球、高爾夫球以及賽車運動等類別的機能型或運動啟發型日常單品。它與知名設計師和品牌通力合作，將運動的影響力融入街頭文化和時尚。PUMA Group旗下品牌包括：PUMA、Cobra Golf以及stichd。該公司的產品遠銷至120多個國家，在全球約有2萬名員工，總部位於德國黑佐根奧拉赫。

title.en: ANTA Sports Achieves Dual ESG Rating Upgrades MSCI ESG Rating Further Upgraded to "AA" This Year CDP Climate Change Rating Upgraded to Top "A" Level
title.tc: 安踏體育實現ESG評級雙躍升 MSCI ESG 評級於年内再升一級至「AA」等級 CDP氣候變化評級升至「A」最高等級
title.sc: 安踏体育实现ESG评级双跃升 MSCI ESG 评级于年内再升一级至「AA」等级 CDP气候变化评级升至「A」最高等级

body.en:
(Hong Kong SAR, 18 December, 2025) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries collectively the "Group"), is pleased to announce that the Group has received significant recognition from leading global institutions for its strong commitment to ESG practices. During the year, the Group's MSCI ESG rating was upgraded to "AA", while its CDP Climate Change rating achieved the highest grade of "A", reinforcing its leadership position within the industry.

According to the latest MSCI assessment, the Group's ESG rating, which was raised to "A" earlier this year, has now advanced further to "AA". This marks the second upgrade in 2025 and positions ANTA Sports as the highest‑rated Chinese sportswear company under MSCI ESG Ratings. ANTA Sports delivered strong performance in key areas including Labor Management, Raw Material Sourcing, Supply Chain Labor Standards, and Chemical Safety, with scores significantly exceeding industry averages. These results underscore the Company's sustained efforts and progress in sustainable development, setting a benchmark for the sector. 

In addition, ANTA Sports has, for the first time, received the highest "A" rating in CDP's Climate Change assessment and been included in the CDP Climate Change A List (Leadership Level), an accolade achieved by only around 2% of companies worldwide. The Group earned "B" ratings in assessments for Forests and Water security, further highlighting its broader progress across environmental initiatives and reinforcing its commitment to comprehensive ESG leadership.

Lai Shixian, Chairman of the Sustainability Committee and Co-CEO of ANTA Sports, said: "We are honored that ANTA Sports' ESG performance continues to improve. These achievements affirm the Group's unwavering commitment to sustainability and responsible operations. Looking ahead, we will take proactive steps to strengthen our sustainability strategy, drive progress in supply chain management, carbon neutrality, and resource efficiency, and uphold our core philosophy of 'Value Creation Through Mutualism', leading the industry towards a more sustainable future."

MSCI is a leading provider of decision-support tools and services for the global investment community. With more than 50 years of expertise in research, data, and technology, MSCI enables investors to analyze key drivers of risk and return and build more effective portfolios. MSCI ESG Ratings assess a company's resilience to long-term ESG risks, scoring firms on an industry-relative AAA-CCC scale based on the most material issues for their business model.

The CDP was established in 2012 and operates as a global environmental information disclosure platform, dedicated to promoting the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions, and enabling environmental friendly decisions for governments and companies. CDP was formerly known as the Carbon Disclosure Project and is also a founding member of the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) and the 'We Mean Business Coalition'. CDP scores are divided into four levels: "A/A-" (Leadership), "B/B-" (Management), "C/C-" (Awareness), and "D/D-" (Disclosure). Globally, only around 2% of companies (approximately 515 companies) received an "A" rating.


–End–


About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991; while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEx in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The mission of the Company is to bring the transcendent sports spirit into everyone’s life. ANTA Sports principally engages in R&D, design, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including footwear, apparel and accessories. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE, KOLON SPORT, MAIA ACTIVE and JACK WOLFSKIN, etc., ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports, Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc’teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).

（二零二五年十二月十八日──中國香港）安踏體育用品有限公司（「安踏體育」或「本公司」；股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台）；及其附屬公司統稱「集團」）欣然宣佈，集團憑藉在環境、社會及管治（「ESG」）領域的堅定承諾及持續實踐，再度獲國際權威機構提升評級，其MSCI ESG 評級再升一級至「AA」等級，CDP 氣候變化評級榮膺最高的「A」等級，持續領先行業水平。

根據MSCI 最新公佈的ESG評級結果，集團的MSCI ESG 評級繼年初升至「A」級後，表現再下一城，年内再度升至「AA」級，成為中國體育用品公司中評分最高者，其中勞工管理、原材料採購、供應鏈勞工管理以及化學品安全四個主要評級領域的得分均顯著領先行業平均水平，彰顯公司在可持續發展領域上的不懈努力與突破，成為行業楷模。  

此外，安踏體育在全球環境信息研究中心（CDP）的氣候變化績效評級中，首次獲得最高級別的「A」等級，並入選領導者名單（A List），全球僅有2%公司獲此殊榮，實屬高度肯定。公司在森林及水安全兩個核心問卷的評估中亦獲得「B」等級，充分展現集團在ESG領域的持續進步及在行業的領導地位。  

安踏體育可持續發展委員會主席及聯席首席執行官賴世賢表示：「我們很榮幸安踏體育的ESG表現不斷進步，這些佳績充分肯定集團在可持續發展及負責任經營上的不懈努力。展望未來，我們會以更積極的行動增強可持續發展戰略，推動供應鏈管理、碳中和及資源管理等領域的持續突破，並堅持『創造共生價值』的核心理念，引領行業邁向更可持續的未來。」 

MSCI是全球領先的投資決策支援工具和服務提供者，在研究、資料和技術方面擁有超過50年的專業知識，致力於幫助客戶理解及分析風險和回報的關鍵驅動因素，建立更高效的投資組合，從而實現更佳的投資決策。MSCI ESG 評級旨在衡量企業應對長期 ESG 風險的韌性，並根據其商業模式，針對最相關的關鍵議題，按行業相對標準在AAA至CCC的評級範圍內給予評分。 

全球環境信息研究中心（CDP）於2012年成立，是營運地點遍全球的環境信息披露平台，致力於推動溫室氣體減排，協助政府和企業作出對環境有利的決策。CDP前身為碳披露項目（Carbon Disclosure Project），並為科學碳目標（Science Based Targets initiative）、「全球商業氣候聯盟（We Mean Business Coalition）」的創始成員。CDP 評級分為「A/A-」（領導）、「B/B-」（管理）、「C/C-」（認知）以及「D/D-」（參與披露）等四個等級，全球僅有2%（大約515 家公司）獲得了「A」等級。 

–完–

關於安踏體育用品有限公司
安踏於一九九一年創立，而安踏體育用品有限公司（股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台））在二零零七年於香港交易所主板上市，是著名的全球體育用品公司。本公司的使命是將「超越自我」的體育精神融入每個人的生活。安踏體育主要從事研發、設計、製造、營銷和銷售專業體育用品，包括鞋類、服裝及配飾。透過多元化的品牌組合，包括安踏、FILA、DESCENTE、KOLON SPORT、MAIA ACTIVE及JACK WOLFSKIN等，安踏體育旨在發掘大眾及高端體育用品市場的潛力。安踏體育亦為Amer Sports, Inc.的最大股東，Amer Sports, Inc.是一個全球的標誌性體育和戶外品牌集團，包括Arc'teryx、Salomon、Wilson、Peak Performance和Atomic，其股票於紐約證券交易所（NYSE：AS）上市。

title.sc: 安踏体育紧急捐赠港币3,000万元现金及物资 全力支援大埔火灾救援

body.en:
(Hong Kong SAR, 27 November, 2025) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries collectively the "Group"), today announced an emergency donation to support residents affected by the No. 5 alarm fire that broke out on 26 November at Wang Fuk Court, Tai Po.

ANTA Sports expresses deep sorrow over the significant loss of life and damage caused by the fire and extends its heartfelt condolences to the affected families. The Group has swiftly mobilized resources, donating a total of HKD 30 million in cash and supplies, comprising HKD 10 million in cash and HKD 20 million worth of cold-weather apparel, to help residents meet urgent resettlement and basic living needs during this transitional period.

ANTA Sports will continue to closely monitor the progress of rescue and relief efforts and remain committed to supporting affected residents through this difficult period. The Group also extends its highest respect to all firefighters and frontline personnel involved in the emergency response, standing in solidarity with Hong Kong during this challenging time.

–End–

body.en:
Showcasing Multi-Brand Sustainability Achievements and Leading the Industry's Green Transformation

(Hong Kong SAR, 12 September, 2025) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries collectively the "Group"), made its debut at ReThink HK 2025, Hong Kong's premier annual event for sustainable development, as the sole sportswear exhibitor. The Group showcased its latest sustainability innovations across its multi-brand portfolio, engaging stakeholders through an interactive booth and a panel session. By sharing its strategic vision and practical experience in sustainability, the Group reinforced its commitment to driving green transformation within the industry alongside fellow business leaders.

Lai Shixian, Chairman of the Sustainability Committee and Co-CEO of ANTA Sports, said, "We are pleased to participate in ReThink HK. As a company committed to upholding its social and environmental responsibilities, the Group has consistently positioned ESG as a core pillar of its development strategy, fully integrating it into our 'Single-focus, Multi-brand, Globalization' strategic framework. Through this event, we aim to share our sustainability journey and achievements with stakeholders across sectors. We firmly believe that advancing technological R&D and fostering cross-sector collaboration are essential to delivering high-quality green products to consumers, and to accelerating the industry's transition towards a carbon-neutral future."

At the conference, Suki Wong, Senior IR & ESG Director of ANTA Sports, participated in a panel discussion alongside industry experts, focusing on low-carbon initiatives and nature conservation within the green value chain. She highlighted the Group's collaboration with over 800 supply chain partners to advance its sustainability objectives. She also outlined the Group's proactive efforts to drive green transformation across the supply chain, including the adoption of innovative technologies such as carbon capture, the provision of professional training for suppliers, and strategic partnerships with organizations such as the World Wildlife Fund (WWF). 

At its booth, the Group proudly showcased its sustainable sub-brand, ANTAZERO, alongside flagship initiatives such as the ANTAZERO Store, the first carbon-neutral brand store in China's apparel and footwear industry to be certified by an independent authority. From design and construction to daily operations, the store exemplifies a holistic low-carbon philosophy. It features a curated range of products that meet ANTA's sustainability standards, offering consumers an immersive green retail experience. Additionally, the Group highlighted its large-scale environmental initiative, the "Mountain and River Project", a nationwide mountain clean-up and hiking campaign. Since its launch in July 2023, the initiative has expanded to over 25 cities across China, promoting the "Leave No Trace" ethos. It encourages the public to embrace outdoor sports responsibly while taking tangible steps to protect the natural environment.

The Group also presented its latest advancements in sustainable innovation across its diverse brand portfolio. The ANTAZERO series features cutting-edge materials, including carbon-capture fabric and PFAS-free membranes. ANTA Kids Chunky Shoes incorporate carbon-reducing mycelium leather, certified by SGS, demonstrating the Group's commitment to environmentally responsible design. FILA unveiled products certified as carbon-neutral, while KOLON SPORT introduced outdoor apparel utilizing fluorine-free water-repellent technology to reduce environmental impact. Meanwhile, DESCENTE, through its long-term sustainability initiative, "RE: DESCENTE", is exploring the use of recyclable materials from the earliest stages of product design. Collectively, these innovations contribute to building a comprehensive ecosystem of sustainable products across the Group's brand portfolio.

ReThink HK is one of Hong Kong's most prominent and large-scale trade expositions dedicated to sustainability. Serving as a vital platform, the event brings together business leaders, sustainability professionals, and experts driving net-zero and ESG strategies. By fostering collaboration among key stakeholders and communities, ReThink HK showcases transformative initiatives and innovative solutions across industries, helping to shape a climate-resilient and equitable future.

As the sole sportswear exhibitor, ANTA Sports presents its latest advancements in sustainable innovation across its diverse brand portfolio.

The Group proudly showcases its innovative product series of its sustainable sub-brand ANTAZERO, featuring carbon-capture polyester fiber and PFAS-free membranes, embodying the concept of sustainability in its products.

The ANTA Sports’ ESG team takes a group photo at the booth, capturing their active participation in the event and demonstrating the Group’s commitment and efforts toward sustainability.

–End–

About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991; while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEx in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The mission of the Company is to bring the transcendent sports spirit into everyone’s life. ANTA Sports principally engages in R&D, design, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including footwear, apparel and accessories. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE, KOLON SPORT, MAIA ACTIVE and JACK WOLFSKIN, etc., ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports, Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc’teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).

展示多品牌可持續發展成果 引領行業綠色轉型

（二零二五年九月十二日──中國香港）安踏體育用品有限公司（「安踏體育」或「本公司」；股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台）；及其附屬公司統稱「集團」）首次參與香港可持續發展界年度盛事 ReThink HK 2025，並作為全場唯一參展的體育用品企業，攜旗下多品牌可持續創新成果精彩亮相。透過展位及論壇，集團向各界分享可持續發展的創新理念與實踐經驗，並與一眾商界領袖探討行業綠色轉型，彰顯其致力推動可持續發展的堅定承諾。

安踏體育可持續發展委員會主席及聯席首席執行官賴世賢先生表示：「我們很高興能夠參展 ReThink HK。作為一家積極履行社會與環境責任的企業，集團始終將ESG視為核心發展戰略的關鍵一環，並貫徹於『單聚焦、多品牌、全球化』的策略佈局之中。藉著本次展會，我們希望與各界持份者分享集團在可持續創新方面的探索與成果。同時，我們相信，唯有持續推動科技研發與跨界合作，才能為消費者帶來更多優質的綠色產品，並與產業夥伴攜手推動整個行業加速邁向碳中和未來。」

在展會論壇上，安踏體育投資者關係及ESG高級總監黃萃琪女士與多位業界專家就綠色價值鏈的低碳實踐與自然保護展開專題討論，並分享集團如何與800多家供應鏈合作夥伴攜手推進可持續發展目標。她亦介紹了集團透過應用碳捕捉等創新技術、為供應商提供專業培訓，以及與世界自然基金會等機構合作，積極推動供應鏈的綠色轉型。

此外，集團於展位重點展示了旗下可持續環保子品牌ANTAZERO的標誌性項目，包括中國鞋服行業首家獲權威機構認證的碳中和概念店—「安踏0碳使命店」。該店從設計、建造到日常營運全方位貫徹減碳理念，並嚴選符合安踏可持續標準的商品，為消費者打造沉浸式綠色購物體驗。同時，集團亦分享了其大型淨山徒步活動「山河計劃」的最新進展。自二零二三年啟動以來，該項目已在全國超過25個城市或地區推廣「無痕戶外」的生活方式，鼓勵公眾以實際行動守護自然環境。

集團同時展示了旗下品牌矩陣在可持續創新方面的實踐成果。其中，ANTAZERO系列應用了創新的碳捕捉科技面料及無氟安踏膜；安踏兒童墩墩鞋使用獲SGS認證的減碳菌絲體皮革；FILA推出了碳中和認證產品；KOLON SPORT的戶外服飾採用無氟防潑水工藝，以降低對環境的影響；而DESCENTE則以其「RE:DESCENTE」長期可持續項目，從產品設計源頭探索廢棄物料循環再生的可能性。這些創新成果共同構築集團全方位的可持續產品生態圈。

ReThink HK為香港最具規模的可持續發展商貿博覽之一，匯聚商業領袖、可持續發展業界人士以及負責研究和推動淨零碳排放和ESG策略的企業。活動旨在凝聚生態圈的持份者與社區，展示社會各界實現ESG轉型的工作及創新方案，共同推動城市邁向氣候智慧與公平價值並重的未來。

作為全場唯一參展的體育用品企業，安踏體育於展位展示旗下品牌矩陣在可持續創新方面的實踐成果。

集團重點展示旗下環保子品牌ANTAZERO的創新產品系列，該系列採用碳捕捉聚酯纖維與無氟安踏膜技術，體現可持續發展的理念。

安踏體育的ESG團隊於展位拍照留念，體現團隊積極參與本次活動的時刻，也展現安踏體育在可持續發展方面的承諾與努力。

–完–

此外，集团于展位重点展示了旗下可持续环保子品牌ANTAZERO的标志性项目，包括中国鞋服行业首家获权威机构认证的碳中和概念店—「安踏0碳使命店」。该店从设计、建造到日常营运全方位贯彻减碳理念，并严选符合安踏可持续标准的商品，为消费者打造沉浸式绿色购物体验。同时，集团亦分享了其大型净山徒步活动「山河计划」的最新进展。自二零二三年启动以来，该项目已在全国超过25个城市或地区推广「无痕户外」的生活方式，鼓励公众以实际行动守护自然环境。

集团同时展示了旗下品牌矩阵在可持续创新方面的实践成果。其中，ANTAZERO系列应用了创新的碳捕捉科技面料及无氟安踏膜；安踏儿童墩墩鞋使用获SGS认证的减碳菌丝体皮革；FILA推出了碳中和认证产品；KOLON SPORT的户外服饰采用无氟防泼水工艺，以降低对环境的影响；而DESCENTE则以其「RE:DESCENTE」长期可持续项目，从产品设计源头探索废弃物料循环再生的可能性。这些创新成果共同构筑集团全方位的可持续产品生态圈。

ReThink HK为香港最具规模的可持续发展商贸博览之一，汇聚商业领袖、可持续发展业界人士以及负责研究和推动净零碳排放和ESG策略的企业。活动旨在凝聚生态圈的持份者与社区，展示社会各界实现ESG转型的工作及创新方案，共同推动城市迈向气候智慧与公平价值并重的未来。

作为全场唯一参展的体育用品企业，安踏体育于展位展示旗下品牌矩阵在可持续创新方面的实践成果。

集团重点展示旗下环保子品牌ANTAZERO的创新产品系列，该系列采用碳捕捉聚酯纤维与无氟安踏膜技术，体现可持续发展的理念。

安踏体育的ESG团队于展位拍照留念，体现团队积极参与本次活动的时刻，也展现安踏体育在可持续发展方面的承诺与努力。

–完–

title.tc: 安踏體育再獲權威機構認可 ESG評級領先75%同業
title.sc: 安踏体育再获权威机构认可 ESG评级领先75%同业

body.en:
(Hong Kong SAR, 8 September, 2025) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries collectively the "Group"), is pleased to announce that it has once again received top-tier ESG ratings from leading international institutions, recognizing its continued excellence in environmental, social and governance (ESG) performance. According to the 2025 Sustainability Rating released by the Hong Kong Quality Assurance Agency (HKQAA), the Group's rating has been upgraded from "A-" to "A". The Group's scores across key ESG dimensions place it ahead of 75% of its industry peers, underscoring its sustained progress and leadership in the ESG field.

Additionally, the Group received an "AA" rating in the 2025 Sino-Securities Index ESG Ratings, ranking first among the 139 companies assessed in the textiles, apparel and luxury goods sector. The Group achieved leading scores across all ESG dimensions, with particularly strong performance in the environmental category. This result further reinforces ANTA Sports' industry leadership and its comprehensive capabilities in sustainable development.

Lai Shixian, Chairman of the Sustainability Committee and Co-CEO of ANTA Sports, said, "We are delighted that ANTA Sports' ESG performance continues to be recognized by leading institutions. These achievements not only validate the Group's holistic approach to sustainable development, but also reflect the integration of sustainability into our core strategic framework. Looking ahead, we will continue to collaborate closely with all stakeholders to advance the implementation of our 'Five Mutualisms' and our '1+3+5' strategic objectives. We remain firmly committed to leading the industry in sustainable development and delivering long-term value."

Since 2014, Hang Seng Indexes Company has engaged the Hong Kong Quality Assurance Agency (HKQAA) to conduct annual evaluations of the sustainability performance of listed companies. These ratings serve as a benchmark for corporate ESG performance and play a critical role in the selection of constituents for Hang Seng Indexes Company’s ESG indices. Drawing on international standards and frameworks, HKQAA assesses the sustainable management systems and associated risk levels. A fact-based scoring methodology is applied to evaluate each company's ability to manage sustainability performance and risk. Assessments are grounded in verifiable implementation evidence, which is used to determine both the maturity of the management system and corresponding risk exposure.

Published by Sino-Securities Index Information Service (Shanghai) Co. Ltd, the Sino-Securities Index (SNSI) ESG Rating adopts internationally recognized methodologies and best practices. Grounded in core global ESG principles and tailored to China's national context and capital market dynamics, the SNSI ESG Rating System provides comprehensive environmental, social and governance assessments for issuers of Chinese A-shares, Hong Kong-listed stocks and other securities. The system covers all A-share listed companies and nearly 700 major Hong Kong-listed firms, representing approximately 95% of Hong Kong's total market capitalization. By integrating both traditional and alternative data sources, the ratings are updated on a quarterly or monthly basis and evaluate ESG performance and risk levels. Companies are assigned ratings on a nine-tier scale, ranging from "C" to "AAA". 

–End–

About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991; while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEx in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The mission of the Company is to bring the transcendent sports spirit into everyone’s life. ANTA Sports principally engages in R&D, design, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including footwear, apparel and accessories. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE, KOLON SPORT, MAIA ACTIVE and JACK WOLFSKIN, etc., ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports, Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc’teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).

（二零二五年九月八日──中國香港）安踏體育用品有限公司（「安踏體育」或「本公司」；股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台）；及其附屬公司統稱「集團」）欣然宣佈，集團憑藉在環境、社會及管治（「ESG」）領域的卓越表現，再次贏得國際權威機構的行業領先評級。根據香港品質保證局最新發佈的二零二五年度可持續發展評級，集團評級由原來的「A-」提升至「A」等級，在社會、環境及管治等核心維度的評分領先75%同業，充分體現集團在ESG領域的持續進步及領先實力。 

同時，根據華證指數二零二五年度ESG評級結果，集團獲華證指數「AA」評級，位列參與評選的139間紡織品、服裝與奢侈品公司之首，其環境、社會及管治維度評分均穩居行業前列，其中環境維度表現尤為突出，充分反映安踏體育在ESG領域的領先地位與綜合實力。 

安踏體育可持續發展委員會主席及聯席首席執行官賴世賢表示：「我們很高興安踏體育的ESG成果再獲得權威機構認可，有關成績不僅是對集團全方位實踐可持續發展的肯定，亦表明可持續發展已深度融入集團戰略。未來，我們將繼續與各持分者攜手合作，全面推進『五大共生』價值，並聚焦『1+3+5』的戰略目標，持續引領行業的可持續發展，創造長期價值。」 

恒生指數公司自 2014 年起委託香港品質保證局為上市公司進行年度可持續發展表現評審。此評級是衡量公司 ESG 表現的有效指標，同時亦為恒生指數公司編制 ESG指數時採用的主要成份股篩選準則。香港品質保證局參考國際準則和框架，對企業可持續發展的系統成熟度與風險進行評級。評級採用以事實為基礎的評分方法，對公司管理其可持續發展表現和風險的能力進行評級，評估人員會根據可用的實施證據，確定系統的管理成熟度與相關風險水平。 

華證指數ESG評級由上海華證指數信息服務有限公司公佈，參考國際主流方法和實踐經驗，借鑒國際ESG核心要義，結合中國國情與資本市場特點，構建華證ESG評級體系，向市場提供中國A股及港股等證券發行人的環境、社會和公司治理三個維度的評級結果。該體系覆蓋所有A股上市公司及近700家主要港股上市公司，市值覆蓋率約佔全部港股市值的95%。華證ESG評級集成傳統數據與另類數據，按季度/月度為更新周期，計算上市公司的ESG表現和風險水平，並給予「C」至「AAA」的九個評級。

–完–

 
關於安踏體育用品有限公司
安踏於一九九一年創立，而安踏體育用品有限公司（股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台））在二零零七年於香港交易所主板上市，是著名的全球體育用品公司。本公司的使命是將「超越自我」的體育精神融入每個人的生活。安踏體育主要從事研發、設計、製造、營銷和銷售專業體育用品，包括鞋類、服裝及配飾。透過多元化的品牌組合，包括安踏、FILA、DESCENTE、KOLON SPORT、MAIA ACTIVE及JACK WOLFSKIN等，安踏體育旨在發掘大眾及高端體育用品市場的潛力。安踏體育亦為Amer Sports, Inc.的最大股東，Amer Sports, Inc.是一個全球的標誌性體育和戶外品牌集團，包括Arc'teryx、Salomon、Wilson、Peak Performance和Atomic，其股票於紐約證券交易所（NYSE：AS）上市。

title.sc: 安踏体育首次入选恒生ESG50指数

body.en:
Releases Roadmap for Phasing Out of High-Risk Substances, Leading Industry Sustainable Development

(Hong Kong SAR, 28 August, 2025) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries collectively the "Group”) has announced its first inclusion in the Hang Seng ESG 50 Index, becoming the only footwear and apparel company in the index among the top 50 Hong Kong-listed companies in terms of Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) performance. The inclusion underscores ANTA Sports' leadership and progress in sustainable development across the industry. In a further step towards environmental responsibility, ANTA Sports has disclosed for the first time the "ANTA Sports Chemical Safety Technical Specification (ANTA Sports J01)" and updated its "ANTA Sports Chemical Management Handbook", outlining a clear roadmap for phasing out high-risk substances. Notably, ANTA Sports has become the first in China's sportswear sector to voluntarily commit to eliminating per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), with plans to transition all branded waterproof products to fluorine-free formulations from 2027.

Constituent stocks of the Hang Seng ESG 50 Index are selected based on the Hang Seng Corporate Sustainability Index (HSSUS), comprising the 50 largest Hong Kong-listed companies demonstrating the strongest ESG performance. The index evaluates companies across three key pillars: environmental impact (including carbon emissions and resource management), social responsibility (including labor rights and community engagement), and corporate governance (including transparency and anti-corruption measures). Only the top 50 scoring companies are selected. The index serves not only as a benchmark for ESG but also provides a reference standard for stakeholders focused on sustainable development.

ANTA Sports has released its first publicly disclosed restricted substance list through the "ANTA Sports Chemical Safety Technical Specification (ANTA Sports J01)", setting minimum product quality and outlining a clear roadmap for phasing out high-risk substances. Complementing this, the updated "ANTA Sports Chemical Management Handbook" introduces best practices across the entire product lifecycle, from raw materials and manufacturing processes to final goods, aimed at enhancing supplier compliance with ANTA Sports J01 and mitigating potential risks.

The Group has established control measures for high-risk substances and implemented a phased elimination timeline:

  • Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS): Aligned with California's AB 1817 bill, using total organic fluorine as the control basis, requiring apparel and textiles exported to the United States after January 1, 2025 to have total organic fluorine content below 100 ppm; the same standards are expected to be implemented in China and other markets by 2027.
  • Alkylphenol ethoxylates (APEOs) and alkylphenols (APs): Starting 2025, the supply chain is required to establish transparent processes and submit testing reports, with ongoing improvement measures based on results.
  • Polyvinyl chloride (PVC): Prohibited in footwear and apparel components from December 2024, with unilateral prohibition from June 2025.
  • N,N-Dimethylformamide (DMFa): Priority promotion of water-based or solvent-free processes to reduce volatile organic compounds.
  • Dicumyl peroxide (DCP) and chloroprene rubber: Prohibited from December 2024.

As a key step in promoting fluorine-free alternatives, the ANTA Brand has also launched the high-performance fluorine-free waterproof and breathable material "AEROVENT ZERO". The material, jointly developed by the ANTA Brand and Donghua University, represents China's first independently developed high-performance fluorine-free waterproof breathable material to achieve mass production. The material uses bio-based polymers to replace traditional petroleum-based materials, providing crucial technical support for fluorine-free alternatives.

ANTA Sports has strengthened its sustainable chemical management framework by adopting internationally recognized chemical management standards and systems. Since 2023, the Group has joined the Zero Discharge of Hazardous Chemicals (ZDHC) Foundation as a signatory brand, successfully onboarding 131 footwear and apparel supply chain partners to the ZDHC Gateway platform. Of these partners, nearly 90% have submitted Performance InCheck reports, enabling chemical compliance assessments against the ZDHC Manufacturing Restricted Substances List (MRSL). From 2025, the Group has also begun implementing ClearStream reporting across its supply chain to monitor wastewater discharge quality, reinforce output-end compliance, and support closed-loop control. To further promote transparency and stakeholder engagement, ANTA Sports has launched a dedicated "Chemical Management" section on its ESG webpage, detailing policy frameworks progress updates.

Lai Shixian, Chairman of the Sustainability Committee and Co-CEO of ANTA Sports, said, "Our inclusion in the Hang Seng ESG 50 Index underscores ANTA Sports' unwavering commitment to sustainability excellence. Rigorous chemical management represents a cornerstone of our commitment to product excellence and consumer protection. Going forward, we will deepen our collaboration with supply chain partners to advance innovation, refine our chemical management protocols, and sustain our position at the industry forefront."

–End–

About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991; while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEx in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The mission of the Company is to bring the transcendent sports spirit into everyone’s life. ANTA Sports principally engages in R&D, design, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including footwear, apparel and accessories. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE, KOLON SPORT, JACK WOLFSKIN and MAIA ACTIVE, etc., ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports, Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc’teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).

發佈高風險物質替代路徑圖 引領行業可持續發展

（二零二五年八月二十八日──中國香港）安踏體育用品有限公司（「安踏體育」或「本公司」；股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台）；及其附屬公司統稱「本集團」）宣佈，首次正式入選恒生ESG50指數，成為唯一入選該指數的鞋服公司，躋身香港上市公司環境、社會及管治（ESG）表現最佳的50家企業之列。此殊榮充分肯定了安踏體育在可持續發展領域的卓越成就與行業領導地位。同時，安踏體育首次披露《安踏體育化學品安全技術規範（安踏體育J01）》並更新《安踏體育化學品管理手冊》，明確高風險物質替代路徑圖，成為中國首家主動承諾淘汰全氟化物及多氟化物 (PFAS) 的體育用品公司，並計劃自二零二七年起將全品牌防水產品全面升級為無氟配方。

恒生ESG50指數的成分股根據恒生可持續發展企業評級（HSSUS）進行篩選，旨在追蹤香港市場中在ESG表現最卓越的50家大型上市公司，評估企業在環境影響（如碳排放、資源管理）、社會責任（如勞工權益、社區參與）及企業管治（如透明度、反貪腐措施）等方面的表現。只有得分最高的50家香港上市企業才能入選，該指數不僅是企業ESG表現的標杆，也為關注可持續發展的持份者提供參考基準。

《安踏體育化學品安全技術規範（安踏體育J01）》為集團首次對外公開的產品限用物質清單，列明產品質量的最低要求，並明確高風險物質替代路徑圖。更新後的《安踏體育化學品管理手冊》則提供涵蓋原材料、製造流程及最終產品的全流程最佳實踐，協助供應商加強對（安踏體育J01）的合規表現及降低潛在風險。

本集團已訂立高風險物質的管控措施，並落實逐步淘汰時間表：

  • 全氟化物及多氟化物 (PFAS): 對標加州AB 1817法案，以總有機氟作為管控基礎，要求二零二五年一月一日後外銷美國的服裝及紡織品總有機氟含量需低於100 ppm；對於中國及其他市場則預計於二零二七年實行相同標準。
  • 烷基酚聚氧乙烯醚（APEOs）和烷基酚（APs）：二零二五年起要求供應鏈建立透明流程及提供檢測報告，並根據結果指定持續改善計劃；
  • 聚氯乙烯（PVC）：二零二四年十二月起鞋服產品主要部件禁用，二零二五年六月起鞋服產品全面禁用；
  • 二甲基甲醯胺（DMFa）：優先推廣水性或無溶劑工藝，減少揮發性有機化合物；
  • 過氧化二異丙苯（DCP）及氯丁橡膠：自二零二四年十二月起禁用；

作為推動無氟化替代方案的重要一步，安踏品牌亦同步發佈高性能無氟防水透濕材料「無氟安踏膜」，無氟安踏膜由安踏品牌與東華大學合作研發，為中國首個自主研發並率先實現量產的高性能無氟防水透濕材料項目。該材料採用生物基高分子取代傳統石油基材料，為無氟替代提供關鍵技術支撐。

通過引入國際先進的化學品管理標準和體系，本集團進一步完善可持續化學品管理框架。自二零二三年起，本集團加入Zero Discharge of Hazardous Chemicals（ZDHC）成為締約品牌，成功推動超 130 家鞋服供應鏈夥伴註冊 ZDHC 網關平台並建立關聯，其中近90%供應商並提交 Performance InCheck 報告，作為其化學品ZDHC生產限用物質清單（MRSL）之合規程度評估工具。自二零二五年起，本集團亦開始在供應鏈推行 ClearStream 報告，藉以驗證廢水排放質量，確保輸出端管控達標，藉此實現閉環管控。安踏體育現已於可持續發展網頁設立《化學品管理》專頁，披露相關政策框架及實施進展，致力提升資訊透明度並深化與各持份者之溝通。

安踏體育可持續發展委員會主席及聯席首席執行官賴世賢表示：「入選恒生ESG50指數是對安踏體育在可持續發展領域不懈努力的肯定，化學品管理更是保障產品品質與消費者安全的重要一環。未來，我們將繼續攜手供應鏈合作夥伴，推動創新研發，不斷優化化學品管理策略與措施，確保化學品管理工作處於行業領先地位。」

–完–


關於安踏體育用品有限公司
安踏於一九九一年創立，而安踏體育用品有限公司（股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台））在二零零七年於香港交易所主板上市，是著名的全球體育用品公司。本公司的使命是將「超越自我」的體育精神融入每個人的生活。安踏體育主要從事研發、設計、製造、營銷和銷售專業體育用品，包括鞋類、服裝及配飾。透過多元化的品牌組合，包括安踏、FILA、DESCENTE、KOLON SPORT、JACK WOLFSKIN及MAIA ACTIVE等，安踏體育旨在發掘大眾及高端體育用品市場的潜力。安踏體育亦為Amer Sports, Inc.的最大股東，Amer Sports, Inc.是一個全球的標誌性體育和戶外品牌集團，包括Arc'teryx、Salomon、Wilson、Peak Performance和Atomic，其股票於紐約證券交易所（NYSE：AS）上市。

发布高风险物质替代路径图 引领行业可持续发展

（二零二五年八月二十八日──中国香港）安踏体育用品有限公司（「安踏体育」或「本公司」；股份代号：2020（港币柜台）及82020（人民币柜台）；及其附属公司统称「本集团」）宣布，首次正式入选恒生ESG50指数，成为唯一入选该指数的鞋服公司，跻身香港上市公司环境、社会及管治（ESG）表现最佳的50家企业之列。此殊荣充分肯定了安踏体育在可持续发展领域的卓越成就与行业领导地位。同时，安踏体育首次披露《安踏体育化学品安全技术规范（安踏体育J01）》并更新《安踏体育化学品管理手册》，明确高风险物质替代路径图，成为中国首家主动承诺淘汰全氟化物及多氟化物 (PFAS) 的体育用品公司，并计划自二零二七年起将全品牌防水产品全面升级为无氟配方。

恒生ESG50指数的成分股根据恒生可持续发展企业评级（HSSUS）进行筛选，旨在追踪香港市场中在ESG表现最卓越的50家大型上市公司，评估企业在环境影响（如碳排放、资源管理）、社会责任（如劳工权益、社区参与）及企业管治（如透明度、反贪腐措施）等方面的表现。只有得分最高的50家香港上市企业才能入选，该指数不仅是企业ESG表现的标杆，也为关注可持续发展的持份者提供参考基准。

《安踏体育化学品安全技术规范（安踏体育J01）》为集团首次对外公开的产品限用物质清单，列明产品质量的最低要求，并明确高风险物质替代路径图。更新后的《安踏体育化学品管理手册》则提供涵盖原材料、制造流程及最终产品的全流程最佳实践，协助供应商加强对（安踏体育J01）的合规表现及降低潜在风险。

本集团已订立高风险物质的管控措施，并落实逐步淘汰时间表：

  • 全氟化物及多氟化物 (PFAS): 对标加州AB 1817法案，以总有机氟作为管控基础，要求二零二五年一月一日后外销美国的服装及纺织品总有机氟含量需低于100 ppm；对于中国及其他市场则预计于二零二七年实行相同标准。
  • 烷基酚聚氧乙烯醚（APEOs）和烷基酚（APs）：二零二五年起要求供应链建立透明流程及提供检测报告，并根据结果指定持续改善计划；
  • 聚氯乙烯（PVC）：二零二四年十二月起鞋服产品主要部件禁用，二零二五年六月起鞋服产品全面禁用；
  • 二甲基甲醯胺（DMFa）：优先推广水性或无溶剂工艺，减少挥发性有机化合物；
  • 过氧化二异丙苯（DCP）及氯丁橡胶：自二零二四年十二月起禁用；

作为推动无氟化替代方案的重要一步，安踏品牌亦同步发布高性能无氟防水透湿材料「无氟安踏膜」，无氟安踏膜由安踏品牌与东华大学合作研发，为中国首个自主研发并率先实现量产的高性能无氟防水透湿材料项目。该材料采用生物基高分子取代传统石油基材料，为无氟替代提供关键技术支撑。

通过引入国际先进的化学品管理标准和体系，本集团进一步完善可持续化学品管理框架。自二零二三年起，本集团加入Zero Discharge of Hazardous Chemicals（ZDHC）成为缔约品牌，成功推动超 130 家鞋服供应链伙伴注册 ZDHC 网关平台并建立关联，其中近90%供应商并提交 Performance InCheck 报告，作为其化学品ZDHC生产限用物质清单（MRSL）之合规程度评估工具。自二零二五年起，本集团亦开始在供应链推行 ClearStream 报告，借以验证废水排放质量，确保输出端管控达标，借此实现闭环管控。安踏体育现已于可持续发展网页设立《化学品管理》专页，披露相关政策框架及实施进展，致力提升资讯透明度并深化与各持份者之沟通。

安踏体育可持续发展委员会主席及联席首席执行官赖世贤表示：「入选恒生ESG50指数是对安踏体育在可持续发展领域不懈努力的肯定，化学品管理更是保障产品品质与消费者安全的重要一环。未来，我们将继续携手供应链合作伙伴，推动创新研发，不断优化化学品管理策略与措施，确保化学品管理工作处于行业领先地位。」

–完–

body.en:
Four Consecutive Years of Domestic Leadership with Globalization Advancing Strongly

(Hong Kong SAR, 27 August, 2025) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries collectively the "Group") today announced its unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2025 (the "period").

Financial and Operational Highlights
(All monetary figures are in RMB unless otherwise stated)

  1. Strengthening marketing leading position: Revenue growth outpaces the industry, topping China market for four consecutive years
    1. The Group achieved revenue of 38.54 billion, increasing by 14.3% year-onyear. This marked the 12th consecutive year of positive growth, expanding the Group's leading position in the China market.
    2. Revenue from the ANTA segment reached 16.95 billion, increasing by 5.4% year-on-year, outperforming the industry average.
    3. Revenue from FILA segment reached 14.18 billion, increasing by 8.6% year-on-year, exceeding market expectations.
    4. Revenue of all other brands surged by 61.1% year-on-year to 7.41 billion, maintaining strong growth momentum and significantly outperforming market expectations.
    5. The Group has completed the acquisition of JACK WOLFSKIN and established a joint management team. A three-to-five-year revitalization plan is being formulated, focused on realigning the product and brand framework around the brand’s core values.
      • The Group has announced a joint investment with South Korean fashion company MUSINSA to establish a joint venture, "MUSINSA China," in which ANTA Sports holds a 40% equity stake. “MUSINSA China” will be responsible for developing the "MUSINSA STANDARD" brand and operating the "Musinsa Store" multi-brand retail concept across the China market.

  2. Achieving high-quality growth: Profit margins and cashflow remain at healthy levels
    1. Profitability: The profit attributable to equity shareholders, excluding the gain from equity dilution under Amer Sports Listing, increased by 14.5% year-on-year to RMB7.03 billion.
    2. Operational efficiency: The Group’s operating profit margin increased by 0.6 ppt to 26.3%, with margins of 23.3% for the ANTA segment, 27.7% for FILA, and 33.2% for all other brands.
    3. Cash flow generation: Net operating cash inflow totaled 10.93 billion, with free cash inflow of 7.55 billion, reflecting the Group's stable cash generation capability. As of 30 June 2025, the Group held 55.58 billion in cash and cash equivalents, banks deposits, and pledged deposits.
    4. E-Commerce business: The Group continued to optimize its e-commerce platform mix and enhance digital capabilities. E-commerce revenue increased 17.6% year-on-year, accounting for 34.8% of the Group’s overall revenue.

  3. Advancing mutual value: Fully practicing ESG and fulfilling social responsibility
    1. Sustained employment creation: As of 30 June 2025, the Group employed approximately 65,500 people, including the recruitment of more than 1,000 recent university graduates. Across the value chain, the Group indirectly supported over 200,000 jobs.
    2. Enhanced R&D investment: R&D expenditure in the first half reached 1 billion, up 8% year-on-year. Over the past decade, cumulative investment in innovation has exceeded 20 billion.
    3. Sustained Charitable Contributions: In the first half, the Group and the Hemin Foundation donated more than 360 million through their dual public welfare platforms. Cumulative donations have exceeded 3.04 billion. The Hemin Foundation also published its inaugural annual report, highlighting donations of over 650 million as at 2024, with projected contributions of 1.13 billion in 2025.
    4. Promoted sustainable transformation: In the S&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment, the Group outperformed 94% of its peers among 190 global textile, apparel, and luxury goods companies, firmly maintaining its leading position in China's footwear and apparel industry. The Group’s MSCI ESG rating has risen three levels to an "A" grade, with its score increasing 2.5 times, reflecting significant progress in sustainability practices. It made its debut on the Dow Jones Sustainability Emerging Markets Index, becoming one of only six Chinese companies selected. Selected as constituent of the Hang Seng ESG 50 Index for the first time, ranking among the top 50 listed companies in Hong Kong for environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance. This recognition fully acknowledges the company’s outstanding achievements and industry leadership in the field of sustainable development.

– End –

About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991; while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEX in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The mission of the Company is to bring the transcendent sports spirit into everyone’s life. ANTA Sports principally engages in R&D, design, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including footwear, apparel and accessories. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE, KOLON SPORT, JACK WOLFSKIN , MAIA ACTIVE, etc., ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports, Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc’teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).
