body.en:
(Hong Kong SAR, 26 August, 2024) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries, collectively the "Group") announced that the Group has been re-selected into the Hang Seng Corporate Sustainability Benchmark Index, with the changes taking effect from September 9, 2024. ANTA Sports has become the only company in the Chinese sportswear industry to be selected, fully demonstrating the Group's leading position in the field of sustainable development and gaining recognition from authoritative institutions.

The Hang Seng Corporate Sustainability Benchmark Index is one of the authoritative indices in the Hang Seng Corporate Sustainability Index Series, first launched in September 2011. The index aims to select the top 20% of companies listed in Hong Kong based on their environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance, providing excellent benchmarks for a corporate sustainability theme. After this review, a total of 97 Hong Kong-listed companies have been included in the index. With a rigorous selection process, the selection for constituent stocks is conducted by the Hong Kong Quality Assurance Agency, an independent professional assessment organization, based on its designed sustainability rating framework.

In recent years, ANTA Sports had continuously increased its efforts in the field of ESG with significant results. In June this year, the Group's greenhouse gas reduction targets were officially certified by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) and it was determined that the targets aligned with a 1.5°C trajectory, highlighting the Group's leadership in climate action. ANTA Sports has pledged to reduce absolute Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions by 42% by 2030 and also committed to reducing related Scope 3 emissions. Additionally, in April this year, the Group launched China's first carbon-neutral store in the footwear and apparel industry, ANTAZERO, in Shanghai. This further highlights the Company's dedication to its "Zero Carbon Mission" and fully reflects the Group's efforts to deeply integrate ESG concepts into its corporate development strategy.

Lai Shixian, the Chairman of the Sustainability Committee and Co-CEO of ANTA Sports, said: "Having been successfully selected in the Hang Seng Corporate Sustainability Benchmark Index once again is a great affirmation for our team. We firmly believe that continuous improvement in the level of sustainability is crucial to the long-term development of enterprises. While pursuing business growth, we are also committed to our corporate responsibility to society and the environment and to achieving our long-term goal of sustainable development. Looking ahead, we will continue to adhere to the concept of 'Value creation through Mutualism', further practicing our core values of 'Mutualism with Consumers, Mutualism with Partners, Mutualism with Employees, Mutualism with the Society, and Mutualism with the Environment', to continually improve and enhance the Group's sustainable development strategy."

ANTA Sports re-selected into the Hang Seng Corporate Sustainability Benchmark Index.

– End –


About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991, while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEx in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The mission of the Company is to integrate the sports spirit of "Going Beyond Oneself" into everyone's daily life. ANTA Sports principally engages in design, R&D, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including footwear, apparel and accessories. Over the years, the Company formed three brand groups: Performance Sports Brands, Fashion Sports Brands and Outdoor Sports Brands, empowering everyone who loves sports. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE, KOLON SPORT and MAIA ACTIVE, etc., ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports, Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc'teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).

（二零二四年八月二十六日──中國香港）安踏體育用品有限公司（「安踏體育」或「本公司」；股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台）；及其附屬公司統稱「本集團」）欣然宣佈，集團再度獲納入恒生可持續發展企業基準指數（HSSUSB）成份股，相關變動將於二零二四年九月九日起生效。安踏體育成為中國體育用品行業唯一入選的企業，充分彰顯集團在可持續發展領域的領先地位，並獲得權威機構的認可。

恒生可持續發展企業基準指數（HSSUSB）為恒生可持續發展企業指數系列中權威指數之一，於二零一一年九月首次推出。該指數旨在甄選出香港上市公司中環境、社會和管治（ESG）表現最優秀的前20%企業，為可持續發展主題投資提供了優質基準，本次檢討後共97家香港上市公司獲納入指數。成份股挑選過程相當嚴謹，由獨立的專業評審機構香港品質保證局，按照其設計之可持續發展評級框架進行可持續發展評級而得出結果。

近年來，安踏體育在ESG領域不斷加大投入並取得顯著成效。今年六月，集團的溫室氣體減排目標獲得科學基礎目標倡議組織（SBTi）的正式認證，確認符合1.5°C路徑，彰顯集團在氣候行動方面的領導地位。安踏體育承諾到二零三零年將範圍一和範圍二的溫室氣體絕對排放量減少42%，並致力於減少範圍三的相關排放。此外，集團在今年四月於上海開設了中國鞋服行業首家碳中和店鋪ANTAZERO，進一步展示集團對實現「0碳使命」的決心，並充分體現集團將ESG理念深度融入企業發展戰略的努力。

安踏體育可持續發展委員會主席及聯席首席執行官賴世賢表示：「安踏體育再度成功獲納入恒生可持續發展企業基準指數成份股，對我們團隊而言是極大的肯定。我們始終堅信，持續提升可持續發展水平對企業長遠發展至關重要。在追求業務增長的同時，我們亦不忘肩負對社會和環境的企業責任，矢志實現可持續發展的長遠目標。展望未來，我們將繼續秉持『創造共生價值』的宗旨，進一步實踐『與消費者共生、與夥伴共生、與員工共生、與社會共生、與環境共生』的核心價值觀，持續完善和提升集團的可持續發展戰略。」

安踏體育再度獲納入恒生可持續發展企業基準指數成份股。

–完–

安踏体育可持续发展委员会主席及联席首席执行官赖世贤表示：「安踏体育再度成功获纳入恒生可持续发展企业基准指数成份股，对我们团队而言是极大的肯定。我们始终坚信，持续提升可持续发展水平对企业长远发展至关重要。在追求业务增长的同时，我们亦不忘肩负对社会和环境的企业责任，矢志实现可持续发展的长远目标。展望未来，我们将继续秉持『创造共生价值』的宗旨，进一步实践『与消费者共生、与伙伴共生、与员工共生、与社会共生、与环境共生』的核心价值观，持续完善和提升集团的可持续发展战略。」

 

安踏体育再度获纳入恒生可持续发展企业基准指数成份股。

–完–

关于安踏体育用品有限公司
安踏于一九九一年创立，而安踏体育用品有限公司（股份代号：2020 （港币柜台）及82020（人民币柜台））在二零零七年于香港交易所主板上市，是著名的全球体育用品公司。本公司的使命是将「超越自我」的体育精神融入每个人的生活。安踏体育主要从事设计、研发、制造、营销和销售专业体育用品，包括鞋类、服装及配饰，多年来形成了专业运动、时尚运动及户外运动三大品牌群，赋能爱运动的每一个人。透过多元化的品牌组合，包括安踏、FILA、DESCENTE、KOLON SPORT及MAIA ACTIVE等，安踏体育旨在发掘大众及高端体育用品市场的潜力。安踏体育亦为Amer Sports, Inc. 的最大股东，Amer Sports, Inc. 是一个全球的标志性体育和户外品牌集团，包括Arc'teryx、Salomon、Wilson、Peak Performance和Atomic，其股票于纽约证券交易所（NYSE：AS）上市。

title.en: Lai Shixian, Co-CEO of ANTA Sports — Selected in 2024 Forbes' "Best CEOs in China" List
title.tc: 安踏體育聯席首席執行官賴世賢入選 — 2024福布斯「中國最佳CEO榜單」
title.sc: 安踏体育联席首席执行官赖世贤入选 — 2024福布斯「中国最佳CEO榜单」

body.en:
(Hong Kong SAR, 24 July, 2024) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries, collectively the "Group") announced that Lai Shixian, Co-CEO of ANTA Sports, was selected for the first time in the 2024 Forbes' "Best CEOs in China" list, marking his success in leading ANTA Sports to achieve all-round excellent performance in terms of financial performance, business operation and globalization.

Lai Shixian has demonstrated exceptional leadership in guiding ANTA Sports since assuming the CEO role last year. Under his stewardship, the Group has leveraged its core strengths, maintained a stable and healthy momentum throughout 2023, and achieved highly satisfactory results. Last year, the Group achieved record-high revenue, with profits attributable to equity shareholders exceeding RMB 10 billion for the first time, solidifying its leading position among Chinese sportswear brands. Concurrently, the Company accelerated its global expansion and enhanced the brand's visibility in international markets.

Lai Shixian, Co-CEO of ANTA Sports, said, "I am deeply honored to be included in Forbes' '2024 Best CEOs in China' list. Our commitment to long-termism will continue to support us in executing more valuable transformations. Despite facing intensified market competition, we seized new development opportunities arising from changes in the market landscape, adhering to our strategy of 'Single-focus, Multi-brand, Globalization' to achieve high-quality growth. Being named in Forbes' '2024 Best CEOs in China' list is also a result of the collective efforts of all ANTA Sports employees. Looking ahead, I am committed to spearheading ANTA Sports' efforts to intensify our global expansion strategy, laying a solid foundation for growth across all brands."

Forbes' "Best CEOs in China" list has been published for 20 years since 2005. The list comprehensively evaluates the specific performance of corporate operations and conducts in-depth research on the CEOs of thousands of companies, including A-shares, China-invested Hong Kong stocks, and overseas-listed Chinese stocks. The evaluation process takes into consideration the market capitalization of the listed companies, stock price performance, net profit and growth rate, return on equity, and other financial indicators and shareholder return indicators. From this evaluation, the list selects the CEOs of the listed companies that rank among the top 50 in terms of overall scores. This list is highly regarded as one of the most credible and honorable rankings for Chinese CEOs.

– End –

About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991, while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEx in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The mission of the company is to integrate the sports spirit of “Going Beyond Oneself” into everyone’s daily life. ANTA Sports principally engages in design, R&D, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including footwear, apparel and accessories. Over the years, the company formed three brand groups: Performance Sports Brands, Fashion Sports Brands and Outdoor Sports Brands, empowering everyone who loves sports. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE, KOLON SPORT and MAIA ACTIVE, etc., ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports, Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc'teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).

（二零二四年七月二十四日──中國香港）安踏體育用品有限公司（「安踏體育」或「本公司」；股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台）；及其附屬公司統稱「本集團」）宣布，安踏體育聯席首席執行官賴世賢首次入選2024福布斯「中國最佳CEO榜單」，標誌著其成功帶領安踏體育從集團財務表現、業務經營、品牌出海等達成全方位的優異表現。

自賴世賢於去年接任首席執行官後，發揮核心領導作用，帶領安踏體育發揮自身優勢，於二零二三財政年度保持穩定健康的勢態，並取得令人滿意的成果。去年，集團收益創歷史新高，股東應佔溢利首破百億，奠定了中國體育品牌的領先地位，同年加速全球化佈局，提升了主品牌於國際市場的知名度。

安踏體育聯席首席執行官賴世賢表示：「我非常榮幸獲入選2024福布斯『中國最佳CEO榜單』。我深信憑藉集團堅持長期主義的精神，將繼續支撐我們執行更多有價值的變革。儘管面對市場競爭加劇，我們把握了市場格局轉變的新發展機遇，堅持『單聚焦、多品牌、全球化』的戰略佈局，致力實現高質量增長。獲納入2024福布斯『中國最佳CEO榜單』，同樣是各位安踏體育員工共同努力的成果。未來，我將帶領安踏體育繼續深化『全球化』發展戰略佈局，為各品牌打好堅實的增長基礎。」

福布斯「中國最佳CEO榜單」自2005年開始發布，至今已發布20年。其「中國最佳CEO榜單」全面評估企業經營的具體表現，深入研究了包括A股、中資港股及境外上市中概股在內數千家公司的首席執行官，並參考上市公司市值、區間股價漲跌幅、淨利潤及增長率、股東權益回報率等基礎財務指標與股東回報指標，挑選出綜合得分排名前50的上市公司首席執行官，評選結果是對中國CEO最具公信力及最高榮譽的榜單之一。

body.en:
(Hong Kong SAR, 4 July, 2024) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries collectively the "Group") has been honoured with nine awards at the "HKIRA 10th Investor Relations Awards 2024" from Hong Kong Investor Relations Association ("HKIRA"). This marks the tenth consecutive year that the Group has received the Awards since their inception. Furthermore, the Investor Relations team has secured the "Best IR Team" award for the sixth year in a row, showcasing ANTA Sports' commitment to excellence in investor relations, which has been widely recognized by the capital market and investment community.

ANTA Sports has received multiple awards from HKIRA, demonstrating its widespread recognition within the investment community.

Anta Sports has received the following awards from "HKIRA 10th Investor Relations Awards 2024":

•    Best IR Company
•    Best IR by Chairman/CEO – Mr. Shixian Lai, Co-CEO of ANTA Sports
•    Best IRO (Investor Relations Officer) – Ms. Suki Wong, Senior IR & ESG Director of ANTA Sports
•    Best IR Team
•    Best Annual Report
•    Best Investor Presentation Material
•    Best ESG (E)
•    Best ESG (S)
•    Best ESG (G)

Lai Shixian, Co-CEO of ANTA Sports, said: "We are deeply honored to achieve such remarkable results at the 'HKIRA 10th Investor Relations Awards 2024'. Such recognition brings tremendous encouragement to our team and serves as a testament to our dedication in implementing best practices in investor relations and corporate governance. Our team actively maintains open and transparent communication with the investment community, enabling the capital market to have a comprehensive understanding of our business progress and strategic deployment. Furthermore, we firmly believe that a sustainable development strategy is an essential part of long-term and steady growth. In the future, ANTA Sports will continue to promote the spirit of 'Keep Moving' and adhere to ESG principles and sustainable development goals while consistently excelling in investor relations."

HKIRA Awards aims to reward excellence in investor relations practices by individuals and companies listed on Hong Kong Stock Exchange. Nominees for the Awards are first put forward by the public. Recipients are then selected by qualified voters composed of buy-side investors and sell-side analysts through online voting. This year, a total of 120 companies participated in the Awards. These awards were voted on by over 480 buy-side investors, sell-side analysts, and fund managers. The Awards are widely recognized by the investor relations community.

– End –

title.tc: 2024巴黎奧運會中國體育代表團領獎裝備發佈 — 中國文化與綠色科技並舉
title.sc: 2024巴黎奥运会中国体育代表团领奖装备发布 — 中国文化与绿色科技并举

body.en:
(Hong Kong SAR, 27 June, 2024) – On 25 June, 2024, ANTA, the leading brand in China's sportswear industry, partnered with the Chinese Olympic Committee to officially unveil The Official Uniform of the Chinese Sports Delegation for Victory Ceremonies for the Paris 2024 Olympic Summer Games at the Shougang in Beijing. Deputy Director of the General Administration of Sport of China, Mr. Zhou Jinqiang, Director of the Equipment Center of the General Administration of Sport of China, Mr. Yu Jianyong, Executive Director and Co-CEO of ANTA Sports, Mr. Lai Shixian, CEO of ANTA brand, Mr. Tsui Yeung, and a number of Olympic athletes gathered to witness this momentous occasion.

Deputy Director of the General Administration of Sport of China, Mr. Zhou Jinqiang (left), and Executive Director and Co-CEO of ANTA Sports, Mr. Lai Shixian (right) hold a handover ceremony for the official uniform of the Chinese Sports Delegation for Victory Ceremonies

Mr. Zhang Yimou served as the creative consultant for the official uniform of the Chinese Sports Delegation for Victory Ceremonies for the Paris 2024 Olympic Summer Games. The design of the outfits features classic Chinese styling with a minimalist color scheme. It combines elements such as "Loong scales" and "Loong whiskers" with embossing, patchwork, and embroidery techniques, conveying the traditional culture of China to the world while showcasing the spirit of perseverance and vitality of Chinese athletes in the new era. Notably, this set of official uniform of the Chinese Sports Delegation for Victory Ceremonies is made from environmentally friendly recycled fibers, making it the first carbon-neutral official uniform of the Chinese Sports Delegation for Victory Ceremonies for Olympic Games in China, certified by authoritative institutions.

Implementing the National Dual Carbon Strategy, ANTA Creates China's First Carbon-Neutral Official Uniform of the Chinese Sports Delegation for Victory Ceremonies 

The official uniform of the Chinese Sports Delegation for Victory Ceremonies for the Paris 2024 Olympic Summer Games has been produced using eco-friendly materials such as recycled nylon and recycled polyester, contributing to a reduction in carbon emissions. The official uniform of the Chinese Sports Delegation for Victory Ceremonies achieve over 50% carbon reduction. Furthermore, certified by authoritative institutions, ANTA has ensured that the carbon emissions throughout the entire life cycle of the official uniform of the Chinese Sports Delegation for Victory Ceremonies — including raw material acquisition, transportation, production, distribution, usage, and disposal — are carbon neutral, making them China's first certified carbon-neutral official uniform of the Chinese Sports Delegation for Victory Ceremonies for Olympic Games.

China’s first certified carbon-neutral official uniform of the Chinese Sports Delegation for Victory Ceremonies for Olympic Games

As early as 25 July, 2023, on the one-year countdown to the Paris 2024 Summer Olympic Games, ANTA and the Chinese Olympic Committee jointly launched the "Mountain and River Project", a large-scale environmental initiative which encouraged sports enthusiasts to collect discarded plastic bottles from the mountains and rivers across the country. In return, ANTA pledged to use recycled materials in manufacturing the official uniform of the Chinese Sports Delegation for Victory Ceremonies for the Paris 2024 Olympic Summer Games. Now, with the official release of the carbon-neutral official uniform of the Chinese Sports Delegation for Victory Ceremonies, the "Mountain and River Project" has achieved significant results and entered a new phase. In the future, ANTA will mobilize more sports enthusiasts to participate in the project through its nationwide retail network and extensive membership community, actively responding to the national dual-carbon strategy and fulfilling corporate social responsibility.

Unveiling the New Olympic Cultural IP "ANTA Ling Loong" to Showcase New Era Chinese Culture to the World

In 2012, during the Chinese Year of the Loong, ANTA first integrated the "Loong" element into the design of the Official Uniform of the Chinese Sports Delegation for Victory Ceremonies, marking the presence of the "Chinese Loong" across Olympic venues in London, Sochi, Rio, Pyeongchang, Tokyo, and Beijing. With another Year of the Loong approaching, ANTA is exploring younger and more vibrant ways to bring Chinese culture to the world. The new Olympic cultural IP "ANTA Ling Loong" was also unveiled at the official uniform of the Chinese Sports Delegation for Victory Ceremonies for the Paris 2024 Olympic Summer Games release ceremony.

"ANTA Ling Loong" made a joint appearance with Chinese Olympic athletes

The new Olympic cultural IP "ANTA Ling Loong" portrays a clever and spirited loong, breaking away from the traditional solemn image. This loong embodies human personality and emotion, reflecting the vibrant spirit of "Generation Z" Chinese athletes on the Olympic stage. In addition to excelling in sports with "Faster, Higher, Stronger-Together" performances, it also exudes a "more dynamic" vitality. Elements such as the loong whiskers, loong scales, and loong claws of "ANTA Ling Loong" are integrated into the design of the official uniform of the Chinese Sports Delegation for Victory Ceremonies. Mr. Tsui Yeung, CEO of ANTA brand, stated at the event that the innovative "ANTA Ling Loong" is a new IP that rejuvenates an era, aiming not only to showcase Chinese loong culture to the world but also to present the world with a new era of Chinese culture.

Chinese women's trampoline team athlete Hu Yicheng photographed with "ANTA Ling Loong"

Partnering with the Chinese Olympic Committee for 16 years, inspiring each other to grow together

Since becoming an official partner of the Chinese Olympic Committee in June 2009, ANTA has maintained a 16-year collaboration, making it the longest-standing brand partner of the Chinese Olympic Committee. During this period of mutual inspiration and growth, ANTA has supported the Chinese Sports Delegation's athletes to stand on the Olympic podium 293 times. Notably, 122 Olympic champions have proudly worn ANTA's Champion Loong uniform, effectively showcasing the spirit and cultural allure of Chinese sports to the world.

The history of the Olympics has witnessed the glorious journey of Chinese sports rising to prominence and standing tall on the global stage. Today, the modern Olympics serve not only as a competitive arena for Chinese athletes but also a global stage to showcase China's cultural confidence and technological innovation. In the journey of promoting the development of Chinese sports, ANTA will keep moving!

– End –


About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991, while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEx in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The mission of the company is to integrate the sports spirit of “Going Beyond Oneself” into everyone’s daily life. ANTA Sports principally engages in design, R&D, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including footwear, apparel and accessories. Over the years, the company formed three brand groups: Performance Sports Brands, Fashion Sports Brands and Outdoor Sports Brands, empowering everyone who loves sports. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE, KOLON SPORT and MAIA ACTIVE, etc., ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports, Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc'teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).

（二零二四年六月二十六日──中國香港）安踏體育用品有限公司（「安踏體育」或「本公司」；股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台）；及其附屬公司統稱「本集團」）欣然宣佈，在二零二四年六月二十五日，中國體育用品行業領導品牌安踏攜手中國奧委會，在北京首鋼三高爐正式發佈2024年巴黎奧運會中國體育代表團領獎裝備。活動當日，國家體育總局副局長周進強、國家體育總局體育器材裝備中心主任于建勇、安踏集團聯席首席執行官賴世賢、安踏品牌首席執行官徐陽及眾多奧運健兒蒞臨現場，共同見證這一榮耀時刻！

圖注：國家體育總局副局長周進強（左）與安踏集團聯席首席執行官賴世賢（右）進行巴黎奧運會中國體育代表團領獎服交接儀式。

2024巴黎奧運會中國體育代表團領獎裝備由張藝謀擔任創意顧問。領獎服的設計傳承經典中式版型與留白主色調，並將「龍鱗」、「龍鬚」等元素與壓花紋路、拼接、刺繡等工藝相結合，向世界傳達中國傳統文化底蘊的同時，也展現了新時代中國運動員拼搏進取、朝氣蓬勃的精神面貌！值得一提的是，本屆中國體育代表團領獎裝備以環保再生纖維打造而成，是中國首套經權威機構認證的碳中和奧運領獎裝備。

圖注：巴黎奧運會中國體育代表團領獎裝備發佈儀式現場，奧運健兒身穿冠軍龍服亮相。

踐行國家雙碳戰略　安踏打造中國首套碳中和領獎裝備

2024巴黎奧運會中國體育代表團領獎裝備，在生產過程中通過使用再生尼龍、再生滌綸等環保面料，有助於減少碳排放，其中領獎服實現超過50%的碳減排。此外，經權威機構認證，安踏對巴黎奧運會中國體育代表團領獎裝備在包括原材料獲取、原材料運輸、生產製造、運輸分發、產品使用和廢棄處置等產品全生命週期內的碳排放實現碳中和，是中國首套經權威機構認證的碳中和領獎裝備。

圖注：中國首套經權威機構認證的碳中和領獎服。

早在2023年7月25日，巴黎奧運會倒計時一周年之際，安踏便攜手中國奧委會共同發起了大型環保行動「山河計劃」，與廣大運動愛好者一同收集散落在祖國山河間的廢舊塑料製品，並承諾以循環再生科技打造奧運領獎裝備。隨著碳中和奧運領獎裝備的正式發佈，標誌著「山河計劃」已取得階段性豐碩成果，並開啟全新階段。未來，安踏將通過全國終端門店體系與廣泛的會員社群，召集更多運動愛好者參與到「山河計劃」的行動中來。持續用行動積極響應「雙碳」國家戰略，踐行企業的社會責任。

全新奧運文化IP「安踏靈龍」揭曉　向世界展現新時代中國文化

2012年中國龍年，安踏首次將「龍」元素融入中國體育代表團領獎服設計中，自此，安踏讓「中國龍」的足跡遍佈倫敦、索契、里約、平昌、東京和北京的奧運賽場。隨著又一個龍年的到來，安踏也在嘗試以更年輕、更鮮活的方式，將中國文化帶給世界。安踏全新奧運文化IP——安踏靈龍（LING LOONG），也在本次領獎裝備發佈儀式上一同亮相！

圖注：「安踏靈龍」與中國運動健兒攜手亮相

聰明伶俐、快意馳飛的「安踏靈龍」，顛覆了傳統中國龍的威嚴形象，充滿人類的個性與情感，是「Z世代」中國運動員在奧運賽場上的生動寫照。在「更快、更高、更強——更團結」的運動表現外，同樣有著「更鮮活」的精氣神兒。「安踏靈龍」的龍鬚、龍鱗與龍爪等元素也融匯到領獎服的前胸、手臂與袖口等設計細節中，使得二者的設計理念相得益彰。安踏品牌首席執行官徐陽在現場致辭中表示，安踏創新打造的「安踏靈龍」，是煥發時代新生機的全新IP形象，我們不僅要讓世界看見中國龍，更要讓世界看到新時代的中國文化！

圖注：中國女子蹦床隊運動員胡譯乘與「安踏靈龍」合影

攜手中國奧委會16載　彼此激勵共同成長

安踏自2009年6月正式成為中國奧委會合作夥伴，至今已有16年，是與中國奧委會合作最久的品牌。在彼此激勵、共同成長的16年中，安踏293次助力中國奧運健兒登上奧運領獎台，122位奧運冠軍身著安踏冠軍龍服，向世界展現中國體育精神與文化風采。

圖注：巴黎奧運會中國體育代表團領獎服發佈儀式現場「靈龍·光環」藝術裝置

奧運發展史見證了中國體育走向世界、屹立於世界的榮耀歷程。如今，現代奧運會已不止是中國體育健兒的競技場，更是展現中國文化自信、科技創新的世界舞台。在推動中國體育事業發展的道路上，安踏將永不止步！

title.tc: 安踏體育榮獲《亞洲企業管治》「亞洲卓越大獎」中多項榮譽 — 包括最佳投資者關係公司、亞洲最佳CEO及最佳投資者關係專業人員
title.sc: 安踏体育荣获《亚洲企业管治》「亚洲卓越大奖」中多项荣誉 — 包括最佳投资者关系公司、亚洲最佳CEO及最佳投资者关系专业人员

body.en:
(Hong Kong SAR, 3 June, 2024) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries collectively the "Group") is pleased to announce that at the “Asian Excellence Awards 2024” organized by Corporate Governance Asia, a leading corporate governance magazine in Asia Pacific, ANTA Sports was awarded Best Investor Relations Company. Lai Shixian, Co-CEO, won “Asia’s Best CEO” and Suki Wong, Senior IR & ESG Director, won “Best Investor Relations Professional”, reflecting the company’s commitment to upholding the highest standards in investor relations and that such is recognized by the industry.

ANTA Sports was honored with “Best Investor Relations Company” presented by Corporate Governance Asia.

Lai Shixian, Co-CEO of ANTA Sports, was honoured with “Asia’s Best CEO”.

Suki Wong, Senior IR & ESG Director of ANTA Sports, was honoured with “Best Investor Relations Professional”

Lai Shixian, Co-CEO of ANTA Sports, said, "ANTA Sports has always upheld the highest standards in corporate governance and investor relations management. We are honored to be recognized by the industry-endorsed organization as a leader in investor relations. We are committed to maintaining effective and transparent communications with the investment community so that the capital market can gain a deep understanding of our business model and strategic initiatives. Looking ahead, we will continue to advance our investor relations endeavors with the spirit of ‘Keep Moving’. We will continue to work closely with our investors and maintain the highest standards of investor relations practices to create greater value for our investors and shareholders." 

The Asian Excellence Awards, organized by Corporate Governance Asia, a prominent corporate governance magazine in the Asia Pacific region, are designed to recognize companies in the region that have demonstrated excellence in corporate governance, financial performance, corporate social responsibility (CSR), environmental practices and investor relations. It also recognizes corporate leaders who have achieved excellence in the field of corporate governance, and the awards are well recognized by the industry.

– End –

About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991, while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEx in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The mission of the company is to integrate the sports spirit of “Going Beyond Oneself” into everyone’s daily life. ANTA Sports principally engages in design, R&D, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including footwear, apparel and accessories. Over the years, the company formed three brand groups: Performance Sports Brands, Fashion Sports Brands and Outdoor Sports Brands, empowering everyone who loves sports. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE, KOLON SPORT and MAIA ACTIVE, etc., ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports, Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc'teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).

（二零二四年六月三日──中國香港）安踏體育用品有限公司（「安踏體育」或「本公司」；股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台）；及其附屬公司統稱「本集團」）欣然宣佈在亞太區權威企業管治專業雜誌《亞洲企業管治（Corporate Governance Asia）》舉辦的「2024年度亞洲卓越大獎（Asian Excellence Award 2024）」中，安踏體育榮獲「最佳投資者關係公司」獎項，公司聯席首席執行官賴世賢先生榮獲「亞洲最佳CEO（投資者關係）」獎項，投資者關係及ESG高級總監黃萃琪女士榮獲「最佳投資者關係專業人員」獎項，反映公司致力秉持投資者關係行業的最高標準，並備受業界認可。

安踏體育在《亞洲企業管治》「2024年度亞洲卓越大獎」中榮獲「最佳投資者關係公司」獎項。

安踏體育聯席首席執行官賴世賢先生榮獲「亞洲最佳CEO（投資者關係）」獎項。

安踏體育投資者關係及ESG高級總監黃萃琪女士榮獲「最佳投資者關係專業人員」獎項。

安踏體育聯席首席執行官賴世賢表示：「在企業管治和投資者關係管理方面，安踏體育始終堅持最高標準。我們很榮幸獲得行業權威機構的肯定，印證了公司的投資者關係工作處於領先地位。我們一直致力於與投資界保持有效且透明的溝通，使資本市場對我們的業務模式和戰略部署有深入的了解。展望未來，我們將秉持『永不止步』的精神，進一步推動投資者關係工作，持續與投資者緊密聯繫，並維持最高標準的投資者關係守則，為股東和投資者創造更大的價值。」  

由亞太區權威企業管治專業雜誌《亞洲企業管治》主辦的「亞洲卓越大獎」，旨在表彰在企業管治、財務表現、企業社會責任、環境保護措施及投資者關係方面有超卓表現的亞太地區企業，並嘉許在企業管治領域取得卓越成就的企業領袖，獎項備受業內人士認可。

–完–

title.tc: 安踏體育氣候目標獲SBTi認證 — 彰顯公司領導力和可持續發展決心
title.sc: 安踏体育气候目标获SBTi认证 — 彰显公司领导力和可持续发展决心

body.en:
(Hong Kong SAR, 3 June, 2024) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries collectively the "Group"), is pleased to announce that the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) has officially validated its science-based greenhouse gas emissions reduction targets, and has determined that the targets are aligned with a 1.5°C trajectory, representing one of the most ambitious designations available through the SBTi process. This significant milestone underscores the Company's commitment to environmental sustainability and its proactive steps towards combating climate change. 

ANTA Sports has pledged to reduce absolute Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions by 42% by 2030 from a 2022 base year and also committed to reducing Scope 3 GHG emissions from purchased goods and services, employee commuting, end-of-life treatment of sold products and investments of 51.6% per USD value added within the same timeframe.

The Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) is a corporate climate action organization that enables companies and financial institutions worldwide to play their part in combating the climate crisis. The SBTi develop standards, tools and guidance which allow companies to set GHG emissions reduction targets in line with that required to keep global warming below catastrophic levels and reach net-zero by 2050 at the latest.

Lai Shixian, Executive Director, co-CEO and Chairman of the Sustainability Committee of ANTA Sports, said, "We are delighted with the validation from the SBTi, which serves as a clear affirmation to ANTA Sports' unwavering dedication and science-based approach to sustainable development. This achievement reflects our robust commitment to integrating ESG principles into our core business operations. ANTA Sports will continue to lead with innovative sustainable practices in the industry, maintaining our dedication to reinforcing our '1+3+5' strategic goals to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050."

In a further commitment to sustainability, ANTA Sports has also launched ANTAZERO in Shanghai, the first carbon-neutral retail store in the Chinese footwear and apparel industry. Officially opened on April 22, this initiative highlights the Company's dedication to its "Zero Carbon Mission", incorporating extensive carbon reduction strategies across all operational aspects of the store.

– End –

About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991, while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEx in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The mission of the company is to integrate the sports spirit of “Going Beyond Oneself” into everyone’s daily life. ANTA Sports principally engages in design, R&D, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including footwear, apparel and accessories. Over the years, the company formed three brand groups: Performance Sports Brands, Fashion Sports Brands and Outdoor Sports Brands, empowering everyone who loves sports. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE, KOLON SPORT and MAIA ACTIVE, etc., ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports, Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc'teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).

（二零二四年五月[-]日──中國香港）安踏體育用品有限公司（「安踏體育」或「本公司」；股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台）；及其附屬公司統稱「本集團」）欣然宣佈科學碳目標倡議組織（Science Based Targets initiative，SBTi）正式認證了安踏體育以科學為基礎的溫室氣體減排目標，並確定這些目標與1.5°C路徑相符，這是通過 SBTi流程追求最高標準的之一。這一重要里程碑凸顯了本公司對環境可持續發展的承諾，以及為應對氣候變化所採取的積極措施。

安踏體育以2022年作為基準年，承諾到2030年將範圍1和範圍2的溫室氣體絕對排放量減少42.0%，同時還致力將外購商品和服務、員工通勤、已售產品報廢處理以及投資方面的範圍3溫室氣體排放量減少51.6%（按每美元附加值計算）。

科學基礎目標倡議組織（SBTi）是一家企業氣候行動組織，旨在推動全球企業和金融機構在應對氣候危機中發揮自己的角色。SBTi制定了各項標準、工具和指引，幫助企業設定溫室氣體減排目標，從而將全球暖化限制在災難性程度以下，務求最遲於2050年實現淨零排放。

安踏體育執行董事、聯席首席執行官兼可持續發展委員會主席賴世賢表示：「我們很高興獲得SBTi的認證。這一成就不但明確肯定了安踏體育以科學基礎方法推動可持續發展的不懈努力，更體現了我們將ESG原則融入核心業務營運的堅定承諾。未來，安踏體育將繼續以創新的可持續實踐引領行業，堅守『1+3+5』戰略目標，力爭到2050年實現碳中和。」

為加強我們對可持續發展的承諾，安踏體育還在上海推出中國鞋服行業首家碳中和店鋪ANTAZERO。該店於4月22日正式開業，店內所有營運流程均廣泛採用碳減排策略，彰顯了公司對「0碳使命」的承諾。

–完–

(Hong Kong SAR, 31 May, 2024) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries collectively the "Group") is pleased to announce its numerous accolades in the field of sustainability development. For two consecutive years, the Company has been selected for Fortune China's ESG Impact List, the only Chinese sportswear company to make the list. Additionally, ANTA Sports received the "Energy Conservation and Carbon Reduction Award" at the 2nd China Enterprise Carbon Neutrality Performance Awards. The Company was also awarded "Sustainable Development Category - Platinum" at the Quam IR Awards 2023, and the "Mentor Pioneer Award for ESG Connect" at the Hong Kong Green and Sustainability Contribution Awards 2024, organized by the Hong Kong Quality Assurance Agency (HKQAA). These accolades reflected the Company's recognitions from reputable institutions in sustainability development.

ANTA Sports was awarded "Sustainable Development Category - Platinum" at the Quam IR Awards 2023.
 

ANTA Sports was awarded the "Mentor Pioneer Award for ESG Connect" at the HKQAA's Hong Kong Green and Sustainability Contribution Awards 2024.

Lai Shixian, the Chairman of the Sustainability Committee and Co-CEO of ANTA Sports, said: "Such recognitions from reputable institutions for our sustainability development efforts is tremendous encouragement for our team. We have always believed that advancing sustainability is crucial. While pursuing business results, we are also committed to fulfilling our corporate responsibilities to society and the environment, striving to achieve our sustainability development goals. Going forward, we will continue to uphold ESG principles and continuously enhance our sustainability development strategy."

For the first time, the "2024 China ESG Impact List" by Fortune China was open to foreign companies operating in China. The number of participating companies surged to over 200, spanning various sectors such as renewable energy, manufacturing, internet, finance, and healthcare. The quality of award entries has improved compared to previous years. The companies that have been recognized demonstrated outstanding effort in improving the environment, protecting employees, and supporting communities, aiming for sustainable and inclusive growth throughout economic cycles.

The "China Enterprise Carbon Neutrality Performance List 2023" is organized by Yicai, in collaboration with the Carbon Neutrality Development Research Institute of Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Shanghai Environment Energy Exchange. The theme of this year's ranking is "From 0 to 1: Carbon Neutrality and High-Quality Development", and signals that companies need to start from the ground up and adopt practical measures to achieve their carbon neutrality goals while maintaining high-quality development throughout the process.

The Quam IR Awards aim to recognize institutions for their performance and contributions in achieving sustainability development goals. In collaboration with consulting firms that provide sustainability development advice to companies, the awards evaluate and select winners in the "Sustainable Development" category from a professional perspective, acknowledging companies that have demonstrated outstanding overall performance in their approach to environmental, social, and governance (ESG) aspects.

The Hong Kong Green and Sustainability Contribution Awards 2024, organized by the HKQAA, aim to promote institutions incorporating good sustainability development practices into their management decisions and daily operations, while recognizing their efforts and contributions. The "Mentor Pioneer Award for ESG Connect" acknowledges institutions that have taken the lead in participating in the ESG Connect program as "Mentor Organisations" and are committed to sharing valuable experiences with the industry, exerting influence to drive ESG initiatives, and supporting the development of the ESG ecosystem.

body.en:
(Hong Kong SAR, 26 April, 2024) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries collectively the "Group"), is pleased to announce that the Group recently released its 2023 Annual Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Report. This marks the ninth consecutive year of publishing the report, which discloses the organization's practices and achievements in the ESG and sustainable development domains. Meanwhile, ANTAZERO, the first carbon-neutral retail store in the Chinese footwear and apparel industry certified by an authoritative institution, was officially launched in Shanghai on April 22. This groundbreaking initiative marks an important step of the Group in exploring a sustainable strategy in the market.

As the first innovative retail store dedicated to achieving comprehensive carbon reduction goals from product manufacturing to operation, ANTAZERO fulfils their steadfast commitment to the "Zero Carbon Mission" in all aspects. Starting from concept initiation, store decoration, to display and sales, it progressively identifies and reduces carbon emissions. Throughout the entire decoration and construction process, measures such as preserving the original walls and floors, using old clothes and patchwork fabrics for enclosures, purchasing second-hand equipment, and repurposing air conditioning and lighting fixtures have already achieved over 30% emissions reduction. Furthermore, detailed carbon footprint assessments identified that the largest emissions occur in the building materials and display equipment, leaving room for further emission reductions. Assuming that 100% of the building materials and display equipment are made from recycled and regenerated materials, and 100% of the equipment is purchased second-hand, along with carbon reduction measures in other areas, it is possible to achieve an additional reduction of nearly 60% on top of the baseline of the first zero-carbon mission store. In the future, in-store operations such as product selection, packaging, sales, and consumer interactions will be guided by sustainable principles. The store will conduct a comprehensive carbon footprint assessment and further promote carbon reduction measures.

Lai Shixian, Executive Director, co-CEO and Chairman of Sustainability Committee of ANTA Sports, said, "Currently, the development concepts of innovation, coordination, greenness, openness, and sharing have become the consensus for promoting high-quality development in Mainland China. ANTA Sports has integrated ESG into its corporate development strategy, committed to creating mutualism value for all stakeholders, and is leading the industry in achieving the transformational upgrade in 'New quality productive forces'."

Collaborating with partners to protect the natural ecology

Sustainable industry development requires collective consensus across the entire industry chain. As an industry leader, ANTA Sports plays a pivotal role, collaborating with partners to actively fulfil environmental and social responsibilities, striving to achieve the Group's carbon neutrality goal by 2050.

The report shows that ANTA Sports has officially joined and is committed to supporting the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). In accordance with SBTi standards, the Group plans to set carbon reduction targets for its business, covering the whole value chain. Currently, the Group has promoted 111 suppliers to use clean and renewable energy and assisted these suppliers in obtaining green certifications. ANTA Sports has also established carbon assessment data management and launched an online ESG data collection platform for its supply chain, supporting suppliers to collect carbon emissions and energy usage data through digitization.

Driving circular fashion, creating green products

Through technological innovation, ANTA Sports has steadily increased the use of environmentally-friendly materials in its products, with the proportion of sustainable products nearing 20% in 2023. Furthermore, the Group launched its first carbon neutral products, the ANTA Storm Mecha Jacket and ANTA Champion Running Shoes 2.0 Pro, in January 2024, which have been certified as carbon neutral according to PAS 2060:2014 standards. Additionally, ANTA Sports is actively promoting sustainable packaging, with sustainable packaging making up nearly 20% of the total packaging material in 2023. The Group has used 9,157 tons of sustainable packaging for its footwear and apparel products, recycled 570,000 shoeboxes, and 18 million sheets of shoe wrapping paper or packaging paper, while 99.9% of its shoe products no longer use plastic bags.

Advancing industry collaboration, building a green supply chain

ANTA Sports has continuously strengthened the requirements for raw material traceability, joining organizations such as the Leather Working Group (LWG) and the Cascale (formerly known as the Sustainable Apparel Coalition), to promote the procurement of sustainable raw materials. The leather used in ANTA and FILA's footwear products, as well as their leather suppliers, are all 100% LWG Gold certified, with over 90% of the leather materials traceable back to their origin.

At the same time, ANTA Sports joined the Zero Discharge of Hazardous Chemicals (ZDHC) Programme and developed and disclosed the "ANTA Sports Chemicals Management Manual". The Group published the "Supplier Sustainability Management Handbook", further clarifying the management standards and creating a mutualism platform with an environmentally friendly, healthy, safe and efficient supply chain. In 2023, ANTA Sports conducted ESG audits on 170 tier 1 suppliers, 119 tier 2 suppliers and 10 tier 3 suppliers respectively. These audits covered environmental and social metrics including labor management, health and safety, labor rights, and green production, among others.

Promoting Diversity and Inclusion, fostering employee development

ANTA Sports attaches great importance to the diversity of our employees, and advocates a corporate culture of respect, inclusiveness, diversity, and openness. In 2023, the Group recruited and hired employees from 13 countries and regions. Among the new hires, about 2,900 individuals represent more than 40 ethnic minorities in Mainland China. Female executives (director level and above) account for 36.6% of total executives. In addition, the Group is actively building its talent pool, with a training coverage rate exceeding 95% and an average hours of training per employee exceeded 29 hours per year.

Contributing to social welfare, deepening value creation through mutualism

ANTA Sports adheres to the corporate value proposition of "Value Creation Through Mutualism" and actively engages in fields such as public health, sports education, rural revitalization, environmental protection, and sustainable community development. In 2023, charitable donations of cash and materials exceeded RMB 300 million. The ANTA "Sturdy Growth Charity Project", which has been running for nearly seven years, focuses on youth sports and supports rural revitalization through sports-education integration. With cumulative donations of cash and equipment over RMB 920 million, the charity project covered more than 6.62 million teenagers at 16,115 schools.

In addition, the Group cooperated with World Wildlife Fund to consistently promote biodiversity conservation. It became a global partner of the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees and a signatory member of the United Nations Women’s Empowerment Principles, joining several sustainable development initiatives and pilot projects initiated by the United Nations. ANTA Brand also collaborated with the Chinese Olympic Committee and initiated the "Mountain and River Plan" environmental campaign. Through its own influence, it encourages consumers, employees, and partners to participate in natural ecological protection. In 2023, the Group's employees actively participated in volunteer services, with an accumulated service time over 30,000 hours.

– End –

About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991, while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEx in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The vision of the company is to integrate the sports spirit of “Going Beyond Oneself” into everyone’s daily life. ANTA Sports principally engage in design, development, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including shoes, apparel and accessories. Over the years, the company formed three brand groups: Performance Sports Brands, Fashion Sports Brands and Outdoor Sports Brands, empowering everyone who loves sports. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE and KOLON SPORT, ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc’teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).

（二零二四年四月二十六日──中國香港）安踏體育用品有限公司（「安踏體育」或「本公司」；股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台）；及其附屬公司統稱「本集團」）日前發佈2023年度環境、社會及管治（ESG）報告，為連續第9年發佈報告，對外披露在ESG及可持續發展領域的實踐和成績。同時，中國鞋服行業第一家由權威機構認證的碳中和店鋪——ANTAZERO安踏0碳使命店亦在4月22日於上海正式啟動，這一零售業態的創新舉措，是安踏體育可持續戰略面向市場的重要探索。

作為首家致力於從產品製造到終端營運全面實現減碳目標的創新零售業態，安踏0碳使命店全方位履行0碳使命，從概念啟動、門店裝修、到展示售賣，逐步排查碳排放量。裝修建造過程中，通過保留原牆體和地面、使用舊衣物和拼接布料搭建圍擋、採購二手設備以及空調燈具利舊等方式，已經實現了30%以上的減排。此外，通過整體數據分析，在建材和道具材料這兩個環節排放最大，仍有進一步減排的空間。假設建材和道具100%採用回收和再生材料、100%採購二手設備，再加上其他環節的減碳，那麼可在首家0碳使命店的基礎上再減排近60%。未來，在產品選品、包裝、售賣，與消費互動交流等門店營運中，該店都將以可持續理念為目標，全方位進行碳足跡排查，進一步推動減碳措施。

安踏集團執行董事、集團聯席CEO、可持續發展委員會主席賴世賢表示：「當前，創新、協調、綠色、開放、共享的發展理念，已經成為中國推動高質量發展的共識。安踏體育將ESG融入企業發展戰略，致力於為所有利益相關方創造共生價值，引領行業實現新質生產力的轉型升級。」

攜手合作夥伴 守護綠色生態

可持續產業建設離不開全行業的協同共識，安踏體育發揮龍頭作用，攜手合作夥伴積極承擔環境和社會責任，力爭在2050年實現集團碳中和戰略目標。

報告顯示，安踏體育正式加入並承諾支持科學碳目標倡議（SBTi），依照SBTi標準，設定全價值鏈減碳目標。目前已推動111家供應商使用清潔能源及可再生能源，並協助供應商進行綠色認證。同時建立碳盤查數據管理，推出供應鏈ESG環境數據線上收集平台，支持供應商通過數字化收集碳排放和能源使用數據。

推動循環時尚 打造綠色商品

安踏體育通過技術創新，不斷提高產品中環保材料的使用佔比，2023年安踏集團可持續產品佔比近20%。同時，集團於2024年1月首次推出碳中和產品——安踏風暴甲衝鋒衣和安踏冠軍跑鞋二代Pro，並已符合PAS 2060:2014碳中和認證。此外，安踏體育積極推動可持續包裝，2023年可持續包裝佔比近20%。目前，鞋服產品可持續包裝使用量9,157噸，已回收再利用鞋盒57萬個，鞋頭紙或包裝紙1,800萬張，99.9%的鞋類產品不使用塑料袋。

推進行業協作 打造綠色供應鏈

安踏體育不斷加強原材料溯源要求，加入皮革工作組（LWG）和可持續服裝聯盟（Cascale）等組織，推動可持續原材料的採購。安踏品牌和FILA品牌鞋類皮革產品使用的皮革原料及皮革供應商均100%獲得LWG金級認證，超過90%的皮革原料均可追溯至原產地。

同時，安踏體育加入危險化學物零排放組織（ZDHC），制定並披露《安踏體育化學品管理手冊》。發佈《供應商可持續發展管理手冊》，進一步明確管理標準，建立環保、健康、安全、高效的供應鏈共生平台。2023年全年，安踏體育對170家一級供應商、119家二級供應商及10家三級供應商開展ESG審核，覆蓋勞工管理、健康安全、勞工權益、綠色生產等環境及社會指標。

促進多元共融 助力員工發展

安踏體育高度重視員工的多元性，倡導尊重包容和多元開放的企業文化。2023年新聘用員工來自13個國家和地區，其中約有2,900人來自中國40餘個少數民族，總監級以上高管中的女性佔比已達36.6%。此外，集團積極建設人才隊伍，員工培訓覆蓋率超95%，人均年培訓時長超29小時。

投身社會公益 深化共生價值

安踏體育秉持「創造共生價值」的企業價值主張，積極投身公共衛生、體育教育、鄉村振興、環境保護、社區可持續發展等領域。2023年慈善捐贈現金及物資超3億元。持續近7年的「安踏茁壯成長公益計劃」聚焦青少年體育公益，以體教融合助力鄉村振興，累計捐贈現金及裝備超9.2億元，覆蓋16,115間學校超過662萬名學生。

此外，集團與世界自然基金會合作，繼續推進生物多樣性保護；並成為聯合國難民署全球合作夥伴及聯合國婦女署《賦權予婦女原則》企業簽署成員，加入了多項由聯合國發起的可持續發展倡議及試點項目。安踏品牌攜手中國奧委會發起「山河計劃」環保活動。通過自身影響力帶動消費者、員工、合作夥伴參與自然生態保護，2023年集團員工志願服務總計超3萬小時。

–完–

關於安踏體育用品有限公司
安踏於一九九一年創立，而安踏體育用品有限公司（股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台））在二零零七年於香港交易所主板上市，是著名的全球體育用品公司。本公司的使命是將「超越自我」的體育精神融入每個人的生活。安踏體育主要從事設計、研發、製造、營銷和銷售體育用品，包括鞋履、服裝及配飾，多年來形成了專業運動、時尚運動及戶外運動三大品牌群，賦能愛運動的每一個人。透過多元化的品牌組合，包括安踏、FILA、DESCENTE及KOLON SPORT，安踏體育旨在發掘大眾及高端體育用品市場的潛力。安踏體育亦為Amer Sports Inc.的最大股東，Amer Sports Inc.是一個全球的標誌性體育和戶外品牌集團，包括Arc’teryx、Salomon、Wilson、Peak Performance和Atomic，其股票於紐約交易所（NYSE：AS）上市。

body.en:
(Hong Kong SAR, 26 March, 2024) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries collectively the "Group") today announced its audited annual results for the year ended 31 December 2023 (the "financial year").

Financial and Operational Highlights

  • Adhering to the principles of "Long-termism", multi-brand strategy has achieved remarkable results:
    The Group's revenue reached another record high in 2023, with a year-on-year increase of 16.2% to RMB62.36 billion. The Group firmly secured top position in the Chinese market. The Group's operating profit margin increased by 3.7% point to 24.6% compared to the previous year, indicating a significant improvement in operational efficiency. From the brands perspective:
    • ANTA segment revenue grew by 9.3% year-on-year to RMB30.31 billion, with its operating profit margin rising by 0.8% point to 22.2%, solidifying its leading position in the Chinese sportswear market;
    • FILA segment revenue increased by 16.6% year-on-year to RMB25.10 billion, with its operating profit margin rising by 7.6% point to 27.6%. Its growth outpaced that of major international brands of similar scale;
    • The total revenue of all other brands surged by 57.7% year-on-year to RMB6.95 billion, with the operating profit margin rising by 6.5% point to 27.1%, sustaining its rapid upswing;
  • Steadily increasing shareholders’ return:
    • The Board has recommended a final dividend of HK115 cents, total ordinary dividends per share is HK197 cents, increased by 47.0% year-on-year; ordinary payout ratio reaches 50.7%, increased by 6.4% point;
  • Stabilizing employment, advocating diversity, and valuing talent development:
    • As at the end of 2023, the total number of employees in the Group had approximately 60,500, maintaining positive growth from the end of 2022; the proportion of female executives further increased to 36.6%;
  • Continuously leading the industry with innovative R&D investment:
    • The annual R&D investment exceeded RMB1.6 billion, with the R&D expenditure to revenue ratio continuing to increase;
  • Amer Sports, Inc. was successfully listed in 2024, and the operation of the Group's joint venture in 2023 continues to improve significantly:
    • Revenue increased by 30.1% year-on-year to RMB31.25 billion;
    • EBITDA increased 45.4% year-on-year to RMB3.75 billion;
  • Robust financial position with strong cash flow: operating cash inflow reached RMB19.63 billion, a 61.6% increase year-on-year;
  • Comprehensive deepening of the value of Mutualism:
    • Mutualism with the Society: donated a total of RMB59 million in cash and over RMB250 million of sports products (calculated at tag value) to various charitable organizations;
    • Mutualism with the Environment: a 3.6% reduction in total GHG emission intensity and a 9% reduction in total water consumption intensity; sustainable products and packaging account for nearly 20%.

Lai Shixian, Executive Director & Co-CEO of ANTA Sports, said, "The Group will firmly adhere to the development strategy of 'Single-focus, Multi-brand, Globalization', continuously exploring the path of globalization through its unique business model of Brand + Retail. The 'Multi-brand' approach aligns with the diverse consumer demands in the multi-level and full range of scenarios in the Chinese sportswear market, instilling us with confidence in the future prospects of the Chinese market and the Group's development. As 2024 Paris Olympics approaches, Chinese athletes will once again compete on the Olympic stage with ANTA’s sportswear. We will continue to strengthen our core competitiveness of 'Multi-brand Synergistic Management Capabilities’, Multi-brand Retail Operations Capability' and 'Global Operations and Resources Deployment Capability'. We are committed to adhering to long-termism and creating value for consumers through focusing on differentiated brand positioning. We are making ANTA Sports a global name with a vision to become a leading multi-brand sportswear group in the world."

- End -

For more 2023 annual results-related documents and information about the Company, please visit our investor relations website http://ir.anta.com.

About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991, while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEx in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The mission of the Company is to integrate the sports spirit of “Going Beyond Oneself” into everyone’s daily life. ANTA Sports principally engages in design, R&D, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including footwear, apparel and accessories. Over the years, the Company formed three brand groups: Performance Sports Brands, Fashion Sports Brands and Outdoor Sports Brands, empowering everyone who loves sports. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE and KOLON SPORT, ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports, Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc’teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).

財務及營運表現亮點

  • 堅持長期主義，多品牌戰略成效顯著：
    二零二三年集團收益再創歷史新高，同比增長 16.2%至人民幣 623.6 億元，穩居中國市場行業首位；集團經營溢利率同比提升 3.7 個百分點到 24.6%，運營效率大幅提升。分品牌來看：
    • 安踏分部收益同比增長 9.3%到人民幣 303.1 億元，經營溢利率同比提升 0.8 個百分點至 22.2%，鞏固中國運動品牌領導地位；

    • 所有其他品牌加總收益同比增長 57.7%至人民幣 69.5 億元，經營溢利率同比提升6.5 個百分點到 27.1%，繼續保持高速增長勢頭；
  • 穩步提升股東回報：
    • 董事會建議派發末期股息每股港元 115 分，全年派發股息每股港元 197 分，同比增加 47%；全年普通股息分派比率達 50.7%，同比提升 6.4 個百分點；
  • 穩定就業，宣導多元文化，重視人才發展：
    • 二零二三年末，集團員工總數約 60,500 名，較二零二二年末繼續保持正增長；高管女性佔比進一步提升至 36.6%；
  • 創新研發投入持續領先行業：
    • 年度研發投入超人民幣 16 億元，研發支出收入佔比繼續提升；
  • Amer Sports, Inc. 於二零二四年成功上市，二零二三年本集團的合營公司經營繼續大幅改善：

    • EBITDA 同比增長 45.4%至人民幣 37.5 億元；

    • 與社會共生：向不同的慈善機構現金捐贈合計人民幣 59 百萬元，以及捐贈運動產品價值（以吊牌價值計算）超過人民幣 2.5 億元；
    • 與環境共生：溫室氣體總排放密度下降 3.6%，總耗水密度下降 9%；可持續產品及包裝佔比接近 20%。

安踏體育執行董事、聯席首席執行官賴世賢表示：「集團將堅定『單聚焦、多品牌、全球化』的發展戰略不動搖，以品牌+零售的獨特商業模式持續探索全球化進程。多品牌符合中國體育用品市場多層次、多場景的消費需求，我們對中國市場及公司未來的發展前景充滿信心。隨著二零二四年巴黎奧運會臨近，中國健兒將再次身披安踏戰袍征戰奧運賽場，我們也將繼續夯實『多品牌協同管理能力』、『多品牌零售運營能力』以及『全球化運營與源整合合能力』三三大核心爭力力，堅持長期主義的使命驅動，聚焦差異化創造消費者價值，向『世界領先的體育用品集團』穩步邁進，做世界的安踏。」

body.tc:
（二零二四年三月十一日──中國香港）安踏體育用品有限公司（「安踏體育」或「本公司」；股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台）；及其附屬公司統稱「本集團」）宣布，凱里 · 歐文（Kyrie Irving）簽約安踏後的第一代簽名球鞋在中美兩地進行首發。這是安踏與凱里 · 歐文的首款簽名球鞋——安踏歐文一代（ANTA KAI 1）。首發配色為「球場藝術家」，無論是概念創意還是設計風格均由歐文本人親自參與設計，高度還原了他在比賽中展現的獨特創造力、戰術洞察力和出色的個人技巧的「球場藝術家」特質。而安踏歐文一代的首發也開啟了安踏與凱里 · 歐文以「鬥士無雙」的精神引領中國運動品牌的全球化進程。

安踏歐文一代全球首發，引發中美兩地消費者排隊搶購熱潮

安踏歐文一代於3月6日（美國時間）在美國達拉斯Deep Ellum的Sneaker Politics開售，這裡是街頭文化中心，上百名美國的消費者早已在店面門口排隊，只為買到這雙「球場藝術家」的配色球鞋。在開始發售之前，凱里 · 歐文親臨Sneaker Politics門店參加首發活動，將現場活動推向高潮。在發售現場歐文與大家一起見證安踏歐文一代正式發售的歷史性時刻。

圖注：安踏歐文一代在美國達拉斯首發，凱里·歐文親臨首發門店

安踏歐文一代於3 月7日（北京時間）在北京王府井旗艦店進行中國區首發，凱里 · 歐文曾表示希望球迷們都能買得起自己的簽名球鞋，中國首發價格為人民幣899元。安踏歐文一代的中國區首發現場吸引了大批球迷和籃球愛好者的到來，並盛讚歐文一代的高性價比，渴望能夠買到安踏歐文一代的球鞋。排隊現場更是引來普通群眾的駐足圍觀。 

圖注：安踏歐文一代在中國區首發，粉絲在安踏北京王府井旗艦店

值得一提的是，在中美首發之後的3月9日安踏歐文一代將在包括紐約、三藩市、杜拜、新加坡、馬尼拉、北京、上海、廣州、杭州、廈門、成都、武漢等全球重點城市開啟全球銷售的步伐。安踏歐文一代的其他配色球鞋也將陸續與消費者見面。此次發售，標誌著安踏全球化戰略正式啟動。

圖注：安踏北京王府井旗艦店，KAI SPACE歐文創想空間

 
凱里 · 歐文全程主導第一代簽名球鞋設計，融合傳承與創新設計

凱里 · 歐文不僅是安踏籃球代言人還身兼安踏籃球首席創意官的職位。而第一代簽名球鞋安踏給予歐文足夠的誠意和尊重。簽約安踏後，歐文便始終與安踏籃球設計團隊保持著緊密的溝通，全程由歐文主導了安踏歐文一代的外觀創意、產品技術和設計概念等，他本人的投入對其個人系列的創意構思發揮了關鍵作用。

安踏歐文一代球鞋傳達了凱里 · 歐文「鬥士無雙」的精神，在產品設計中融合了歐文的設計理念和審美標準，創造出了兼具性能和美感的產品。球鞋的流線型輪廓呼應了歐文在場上充滿技巧的動作，而鞋面上的歐文密碼則為這款球鞋增添了特殊的與粉絲溝通的設計語言。鞋上的圖案靈感來源於歐文的比賽特點，同時也與歐文的家族文化緊密相連，賦予他超凡的力量、敏捷、專注和速度。球鞋的細節之處，如鞋帶扣上用歐文密碼表達的安踏字樣，後跟EVA框架上刻有的「過程即是獎賞」，以及鞋面綁帶上歐文密碼拼寫的凱里 · 歐文名字都體現了產品設計的巧思和深意。

圖注：安踏歐文一代產品設計細節圖

凱里 · 歐文表示：「作為安踏籃球代言人兼首席創意官，我將我的傳承和對籃球的熱愛融入了安踏歐文一代的設計之中。它不僅僅是一雙鞋，它承載著我們的信仰力量，同時也代表了我們正在構建的未來。從歐文密碼到空氣動力學，每一個設計細節都講述了我們的過去和未來。歡迎與我一同踏入新的篇章。」

安踏歐文一代全球市場發售，加速安踏品牌的全球化進程

隨著安踏歐文一代的推出，安踏和凱里 · 歐文還將邀請運動員、藝術家、創作者和各大球鞋媒體來體驗球鞋，它不僅是一款運動裝備，還是一件敘事作品——傳統、性能和前沿設計的融合。不僅如此，安踏還將攜手歐文在全球範圍內開展公益行動。以籃球為溝通紐帶積極推廣籃球運動的普及，提供籃球的專業運動裝備，助力貧困地區青少年籃球的發展。

圖注：美國達拉斯首發現場，安踏歐文一代引發搶購熱潮

安踏歐文一代在全球的上市，將進一步打開國際市場與國際一流品牌同場較量，彰顯中國運動品牌的實力與信心。未來，安踏將與安踏籃球首席創意官凱里 · 歐文，共同啟動屬於中國運動品牌的全球化征程。雙方攜手以「鬥士無雙」的精神代表中國運動品牌角逐全球化的新時代「以全球化的視野，實現全球化事業」。

圖注：安踏歐文一代穿著體驗細節圖


–完–


 
關於安踏體育用品有限公司
安踏於一九九一年創立，而安踏體育用品有限公司（股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台））在二零零七年於香港交易所主板上市，是著名的全球體育用品公司。本公司的使命是將超越自我的體育精神融入每個人的生活。安踏體育主要從事設計、研發、製造、營銷和銷售體育用品，包括鞋履、服裝及配飾，多年來形成了專業運動、時尚運動及戶外運動三大品牌群，賦能愛運動的每一個人。透過多元化的品牌組合，包括安踏、FILA、DESCENTE及KOLON SPORT，安踏體育旨在發掘大眾及高端體育用品市場的潜力。安踏體育亦為Amer Sports Inc.的最大股東，Amer Sports Inc.是一個全球的標誌性體育和戶外品牌集團，包括Arc’teryx、Salomon、Wilson、Peak Performance和Atomic，其股票於紐約交易所（NYSE：AS）上市。

安踏歐文一代全球首發 安踏攜手凱里 · 歐文開啟全球化進程

（二零二四年三月十一日──中国香港）安踏体育用品有限公司（「安踏体育」或「本公司 」；股份代号：2020（港币柜台）及82020（人民币柜台）；及其附属公司统称「本集团」）宣布，凯里· 欧文（Kyrie Irving）签约安踏后的第一代签名球鞋在中美两 地进行首发。 这是安踏与凯里 · 欧文的首款签名球鞋——安踏欧文一代（ANTA KAI 1）。 首发配色为「球场艺术家」，无论是概念创意还是设计风格均由欧文本人亲自参与设计，高度还原了他在比赛中展现的独特创造力、战术洞察力和出色的个人技巧的「球场艺术家」特质 。 而安踏欧文一代的首发也开启了安踏与凯里 · 欧文以「斗士无双」的精神引领中国运动品牌的全球化进程。

安踏欧文一代全球首发，引发中美两地消费者排队抢购热潮

安踏欧文一代于3月6日（美国时间）在美国达拉斯Deep Ellum的Sneaker Politics开售，这里是街头文化中心，上百名美国的消费者早已在 店面门口排队，只为买到这双「球场艺术家」的配色球鞋。 在开始发售之前，凯里 · 欧文亲临Sneaker Politics门店参加首发活动，将现场活动推向高潮。 在发售现场欧文与大家一起见证安踏欧文一代正式发售的历史性时刻。

图注：安踏欧文一代在美国达拉斯首发，凯里·欧文亲临首发门店

安踏欧文一代于3 月7日（北京时间）在北京王府井旗舰店进行中国区首发，凯里· 欧文曾表示希望球迷们都能买得起自己 的签名球鞋，中国首发价格为人民币899元。 安踏欧文一代的中国区首发现场吸引了大批球迷和篮球爱好者的到来，并盛赞欧文一代的高性价比，渴望能够买到安踏欧文一代的球鞋。 排队现场更是引来普通群众的驻足围观。  

图注：安踏欧文一代在中国区首发，粉丝在安踏北京王府井旗舰店

值得一提的是，在中美首发之后的3月9日安踏欧文一代将在包括纽约、三藩市、杜拜、新加坡、马尼拉、北京、 上海、广州、杭州、厦门、成都、武汉等全球重点城市开启全球销售的步伐。 安踏欧文一代的其他配色球鞋也将陆续与消费者见面。 此次发售，标志着安踏全球化战略正式启动。

图注：安踏北京王府井旗舰店，KAI SPACE欧文创想空间

 
凯里 · 欧文全程主导第一代签名球鞋设计，融合传承与创新设计

凯里 · 欧文不仅是安踏篮球代言人还身兼安踏篮球首席创意官的职位。 而第一代签名球鞋安踏给予欧文足够的诚意和尊重。 签约安踏后，欧文便始终与安踏篮球设计团队保持着紧密的沟通，全程由欧文主导了安踏欧文一代的外观创意、产品技术和设计概念等，他本人的投入对其个人系列的创意构思发挥了 关键作用。

安踏欧文一代球鞋传达了凯里· 欧文「斗士无双」的精神，在产品设计中融合了欧文的设计理念和审美标准，创造出了兼具性能 和美感的产品。 球鞋的流线型轮廓呼应了欧文在场上充满技巧的动作，而鞋面上的欧文密码则为这款球鞋增添了特殊的与粉丝沟通的设计语言。 鞋上的图案灵感来源于欧文的比赛特点，同时也与欧文的家族文化紧密相连，赋予他超凡的力量、敏捷、专注和速度。 球鞋的细节之处，如鞋带扣上用欧文密码表达的安踏字样，后跟EVA框架上刻有的「过程即是奖赏」，以及鞋面绑带上欧文密码拼写的凯里· 欧文名字都 体现了产品设计的巧思和深意。

图注：安踏欧文一代产品设计细节图

凯里· 欧文表示：「作为安踏篮球代言人兼首席创意官，我将我的传承和对篮球的热爱融入了安踏欧文 一代的设计之中。它不仅仅是一双鞋，它承载着我们的信仰力量，同时也代表了我们正在构建的未来。从欧文密码到空气动力学，每一个设计细节都讲述了我们的过去 和未来。欢迎与我一同踏入新的篇章。」

安踏欧文一代全球市场发售，加速安踏品牌的全球化进程

随着安踏欧文一代的推出，安踏和凯里· 欧文还将邀请运动员、艺术家、创作者和各大球鞋媒体来体验球鞋，它不仅是一款 运动装备，还是一件叙事作品——传统、性能和前沿设计的融合。 不仅如此，安踏还将携手欧文在全球范围内开展公益行动。 以篮球为沟通纽带积极推广篮球运动的普及，提供篮球的专业运动装备，助力贫困地区青少年篮球的发展。

图注：美国达拉斯首发现场，安踏欧文一代引发抢购热潮

安踏欧文一代在全球的上市，将进一步打开国际市场与国际一流品牌同场较量，彰显中国运动品牌的实力与信心。 未来，安踏将与安踏篮球首席创意官凯里 · 欧文，共同启动属于中国运动品牌的全球化征程。 双方携手以「斗士无双」的精神代表中国运动品牌角逐全球化的新时代「以全球化的视野，实现全球化事业」。

图注：安踏欧文一代穿着体验细节图


–完–

body.en:
Showcases the Company’s outstanding achievements in sustainable development

(Hong Kong SAR, 21 February, 2024) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries collectively the "Group"), is pleased to announce that MSCI, a reputable international index provider, has released the latest Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) rating results, and with its outstanding performance in ESG, ANTA Sports has seen its MSCI ESG rating rise by two levels to "BBB", making it the highest-scoring Chinese sportswear company. ANTA Sports has shown improvement in all seven areas covered by the MSCI ESG rating, with the most significant progress observed in chemical safety, labor management and raw material sourcing. These advancements reflect the Group's dedicated efforts, including its commitment to gradually reduce and eventually eliminate the use of harmful and restricted chemicals, the 100% use of leather materials certified by the Leather Working Group Gold Standard on ANTA and FILA footwear products, thus ensuring traceability to their origin, as well as its commitment to follow the international standards as a member of the United Nations Global Compact (UNGC) and United Nations Women's Empowerment Principles (WEPs), aligning with internationally recognized human rights policies and promoting an inclusive and diverse corporate culture.

Lai Shixian, Co-CEO of ANTA Sports, said, "We are delighted with ANTA Sports' exemplary performance in the MSCI ESG assessment, which demonstrates the Group's determination and fruitful results in integrating ESG into our strategic development. ANTA Sports is committed to leading sustainable development standards within the industry, from R&D and production processes to the sourcing of raw materials. ESG and sustainable development will continue to play a significant role in our future development plans. Looking ahead, ANTA Sports will continue to create value through mutualism with consumers, partners, the environment, society, and our employees, driving sustainable development and upholding our social and environmental responsibilities, while actively advancing the Group's '1+3+5' sustainable strategic goals."

As an industry leader, ANTA Sports established a Sustainability Committee to ensure active participation in sustainability issues at the board level. The Company continues to strengthen its corporate governance practices and improve its ESG governance structure. ANTA Sports adheres to the principle of "Value Creation Through Mutualism", leading the industry, business partners and consumers towards a sustainable future through the core values of "Mutualism with Consumers", "Mutualism with Partners", "Mutualism with Employees", "Mutualism with the Society", and "Mutualism with the Environment". Furthermore, ANTA Sports actively pursues growth opportunities in innovative products, green supply chains, environmental protection and public welfare, and other areas that align with the shareholders' interests, in order to achieve high-quality and robust sustainable development.

MSCI is a leading provider of critical decision support tools and services for the global investment community. With over 50 years of expertise in research, data and technology, MSCI powers better investment decisions by enabling clients to understand and analyze key drivers of risk and return and confidently build more effective portfolios. The MSCI ESG rating aims to assess a company's level of risk exposure and management capabilities in areas such as ESG. It also compares companies within the same industry to identify leaders and laggards in managing these risks. The assessment scope covers seven major areas. The rating is applicable to stocks, fixed-income securities, loans, mutual funds, ETFs, and countries.

– End –

About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991, while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEx in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The vision of the company is to integrate the sports spirit of “Going Beyond Oneself” into everyone’s daily life. ANTA Sports principally engage in design, development, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including shoes, apparel and accessories. Over the years, the company formed three brand groups: Performance Sports Brands, Fashion Sports Brands and Outdoor Sports Brands, empowering everyone who loves sports. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE and KOLON SPORT, ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc’teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).

body.tc:
充分展現公司於可持續發展工作的卓越成果

（二零二四年二月二十一日──中國香港）安踏體育用品有限公司（「安踏體育」或「本公司」；股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台）；及其附屬公司統稱「本集團」）欣然宣布，國際權威指數機構MSCI公布最新環境、社會及管治（ESG）評級結果。憑藉在ESG方面的優異管理表現，安踏體育MSCI ESG評級連升兩級至「BBB」級，是中國體育用品公司中分數最高。在MSCI ESG評級七大範圍中，安踏體育各項領域均獲提升，其中，化學品安全、勞工管理及原材料塑源方面提升幅度最大，充分反映了集團在該方面的努力，包括承諾逐步減少至停止使用有害及受限化學品，安踏和FILA鞋類皮革產品100%使用皮革工作組織金級認證的皮革原材料，均可溯源至原產地，以及作為聯合國全球契約組織（UNGC）成員和聯合國婦女署《賦權予婦女原則》（WEPs）全球簽署企業成員，遵循國際公認的人權政策，尊重包容和多元開放的企業文化等。

安踏體育聯席首席執行官賴世賢表示：「我們很高興安踏體育在MSCI ESG評估中表現優秀，充分反映集團積極將ESG融入集團戰略發展的堅定決心及豐碩成果。安踏體育一直秉持引領行業標準的可持續發展，不論是由研發、生產流程以及原材料等，集團均為可持續發展全力投入。在集團未來發展規劃中，ESG與可持續發展將繼續佔有重要地位。未來，安踏體育會繼續通過與消費者、生態夥伴、環境、社會及員工等各持份者締造共生價值，推動可持續發展，肩負起對社會和環境的責任，積極推進集團的『1+3+5』可持續戰略目標。」

作為行業領導者，安踏體育成立可持續發展委員會，實現從董事會層面參與可持續發展事務，並不斷加強公司管治水平，完善集團的ESG架構。集團秉持「創造共生價值」的理念，引領行業、合作夥伴和消費者邁向可持續的未來，並建立「與消費者共生、與夥伴共生、與員工共生、與社會共生、與環境共生」的核心價值觀。在創新產品、綠色供應鏈、環保公益等方面持續探索與持份者相關的利益增長點，實現高品質、穩健的可持續發展。

MSCI是全球領先的投資決策支援工具和服務提供者。公司在研究、資料和技術方面擁有超過50年的專業知識，致力於幫助客戶理解及分析風險和回報的關鍵驅動因素，建立更有效的投資組合，從而實現更好的投資決策。MSCI ESG 評級旨在衡量公司在環境、社會和管治（ESG）等方面的風險暴露程度和管理能力，並比較同業就管理該風險的情況來識別行業領先者和落後者，評核範圍涵蓋七大範疇。公司也對股票和固定收益證券、貸款、共同基金、ETF和國家進行評級。

body.en:
and Wins Huxiu 2023 Sustainability Role Model Award

(Hong Kong SAR, 8 February, 2024) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries collectively the "Group"), is pleased to announce that it has, for the first time, been assessed in the 2023 annual climate change performance rating by the CDP and has received a B score (Management level), which not only surpasses the global and Asia regional average of C, but also the Discretionary retail sector average of B-. It is the highest score among Chinese sporting goods companies, reflecting ANTA Sports' achievements in reducing greenhouse gas emissions and environmental information disclosure. Additionally, ANTA Sports has been selected for the Huxiu 2023 Sustainability Role Model Award, which underscores the Company's exceptional performance in sustainable development and recognition from authoritative institutions.

ANTA Sports adheres to its commitment to sustainable development and has established the ‘1+3+5’ sustainable strategic goals, pledging to achieve carbon neutrality at the group level by 2050. ANTA Sports also formally joined and pledged to support the commitment of SBTi in January 2023, setting carbon reduction targets across the entire industry value chain. We actively promote sustainable packaging to reduce the impact of excessive packaging on the planet and have set clear requirements for the use of chemicals in our products, committing to the gradual reduction and eventual cessation of the use of harmful and restricted chemicals. As an international partner of the World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF), we continue to invest in biodiversity conservation and value the environmental friendliness of our products.

Lai Shixian, Co-CEO of ANTA Sports, said, "ANTA Sports has been adhering to sustainable development that leads the industry standard, and we are honored to receive such recognition from authoritative organizations once again. These accolades serve as great encouragement for our team. While pursuing business results, ANTA Sports will continue to uphold ESG principles, strive for breakthroughs in supply chain management, carbon neutrality, and other goals, and take more  action to enhance our sustainable development strategy, adhering to the philosophy of 'creating mutual growth value.'" 

The CDP was established in 2012, focusing on operating a global environmental information disclosure platform, dedicated to promoting the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions, and the protection of water and forest resources. CDP was formerly known as the Carbon Disclosure Project and is also a founding member of the SBTis and the 'We Mean Business Coalition'. CDP scores are divided into four levels: "A/A-" (Leadership), "B/B-" (Management), "C/C-" (Awareness), and "D/D-" (Disclosure).

The Huxiu 2023 Sustainability Role Model Award, organized by the Huxiu ESG team, aims to recognize Chinese enterprises with outstanding contributions in the ESG field. The evaluation focuses on whether enterprises respond to social needs through practical actions, making the ESG values of the enterprise more recognized by the public. The evaluation criteria extend from ESG aspects into 11 major indicators, screening through the ESG data and reporting materials of enterprises in categories such as A-shares, H-shares, and Chinese concept stocks, ultimately selecting 10 'Sustainability Role Model' enterprises. The winning enterprises have made significant breakthroughs in ESG, clearly responding to the ESG concerns of the public, creating social and ecological value, and enhancing their own performance and potential for sustainable development.

– End –

About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991, while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEx in 2007 (Stock Codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter)). The vision of the company is to integrate the sports spirit of “Going Beyond Oneself” into everyone’s daily life. ANTA Sports principally engage in design, development, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including shoes, apparel and accessories. Over the years, the company formed three brand groups: Performance Sports Brands, Fashion Sports Brands and Outdoor Sports Brands, empowering everyone who loves sports. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE and KOLON SPORT, ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets. ANTA Sports is also the largest shareholder of Amer Sports Inc., a global group of iconic sports and outdoor brands, including Arc’teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, whose shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AS).

及獲選虎嗅2023可持續品牌典範獎

（二零二四年二月八日──中國香港）安踏體育用品有限公司（「安踏體育」或「本公司」；股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台）欣然宣布，首次參評2023年度全球環境信息研究中心（CDP）的氣候變化績效評級並獲得B等級（管理），不但高於全球及亞洲地區平均的C 評級，也高於非必需消費零售業的B- 評級，是中國體育用品公司中評級最高，反映安踏體育在減少溫室氣體排放及環境信息披露方面均取得成果。另外，安踏體育更獲選虎嗅2023可持續品牌典範獎，充分展現公司於可持續發展工作的卓越表現，獲得權威機構的高度認可。

安踏體育一直堅守對可持續發展的承諾，並已制定了『1+3+5』的可持續戰略目標，承諾到二零五零年在集團層面實現碳中和。二零二三年一月，我們正式加入並承諾支持科學碳目標倡議（SBTi），為業務擬定全產業鏈週期的減碳目標。我們積極推進可持續包裝，以減少過度包裝對地球的影響，並明確產品中化學品使用要求，承諾逐步減少至停止使用有害及受限化學品。作為世界自然基金會的全球戰略合作夥伴，我們持續投入生物多樣性保護工作中，並重視產品的環境友好屬性。

安踏體育聯席首席執行官賴世賢表示：「安踏體育一直秉持引領行業標準的可持續發展，我們很榮幸能夠再度獲得權威機構的認可，為我們團隊帶來極大的鼓舞。展望將來，在追求業務成果的同時，安踏體育將繼續秉持ESG理念，於供應鏈管理、碳中和等目標上不斷突破，以更積極的行動增強可持續發展戰略，堅持『創造共生價值』的理念。」 

全球環境信息研究中心（CDP）成立於2012年，專注於在全球運營環境信息披露平台，致力於推動減少溫室氣體排放，保護水和森林資源。CDP前身為碳披露項目（Carbon Disclosure Project），還是科學碳目標（Science Based Targets initiative）、「全球商業氣候聯盟（We Mean Business Coalition）」的創始成員。CDP 評級分為「A/A-」（領導）、「B/B-」（管理）、「C/C-」（認知）以及「D/D-」（參與披露）等四個等級。獲得「B」級評級足證企業成功在氣候問題上採取協調行動。

「2023可持續品牌典範」由虎嗅ESG團隊主辦，旨在表彰在ESG領域有卓越貢獻、的中國企業。評選注重企業是否透過實際行動回應社會需要，使企業的ESG價值更為公眾認可。評獎標準從環境、社會、治理層面延伸成11個大指標，並於A股、H股、中概股等範疇企業的ESG數據及申報資料中進行篩選，最終選出10家「可持續品牌典範」企業。獲獎企業均在ESG方面取得重大突破，明確回應社會公眾的ESG關切，創造社會和生態價值，並提升自身業績和可持續發展潛力。

–完–

body.en:
Adhering to the "1+3+5" Strategic Goal, Aims to Become a World-leading Sustainable Enterprise

(Hong Kong SAR, 20 October, 2023) – ANTA Sports Products Limited ("ANTA Sports" or the "Company", stock codes: 2020 (HKD counter) and 82020 (RMB counter), and its subsidiaries collectively the "Group"), was invited to attend today's United Nations Global Compact (UNGC) "Forward Faster" initiative conference. ANTA Sports is among the first group of Chinese companies to join the "Forward Faster" initiative, taking a leading role in climate action commitments. It is also the only textile and apparel company participating in this initiative. At the conference, Mr. Ivan Lim, Vice President, Group Apparel & Accessories & Gear Sourcing at ANTA Sports, presented the Company’s strategic objectives and outstanding achievements in the field of sustainable development through sustainable packaging, energy conservation and carbon reduction and corporate governance. 

Mr. Ivan Lim, Vice President, Group Apparel & Accessories & Gear Sourcing at ANTA Sports (second from the left) with representatives from participating companies and the UNGC.

Mr. Ivan Lim, Vice President, Group Apparel & Accessories & Gear Sourcing at ANTA Sports, said, "ANTA Sports has always remained committed to sustainable development and is determined to become a world-leading sustainable benchmarking enterprise. The Group has already established the '1+3+5' sustainable strategic goal, pledging to achieve carbon neutrality at the group level by 2050. ANTA Sports also formally joined and pledged to support the commitment of SBTi in January 2023, setting carbon reduction targets across the entire industry value chain. As one of the pioneering Chinese companies to join the UNGC's 'Forward Faster' initiative, ANTA Sports will continue to lead the industry through innovation and collaboration and actively promote sustainable development across the entire industry value chain, striving to achieve greater breakthroughs in our vision for sustainable development."

Actively boosts use of eco-friendly materials, leading the way in sustainable consumption
Through R&D and technological innovation, ANTA Sports has continuously strived to enhance the utilization of eco-friendly materials. Over 50% of FILA's footwear products use sustainable packaging, and the shoe packaging paper and paper shoe tree of the DESCENTE brand have obtained Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) and Global Recycle Standard (GRS) certification respectively. ANTA Sports also aims to have 50% of its products embody sustainable development principles by 2023, with products using sustainable packaging and sustainable raw materials.

Improving corporate governance level from top to bottom
In terms of corporate governance, ANTA Sports established a Sustainability Committee to ensure active participation in sustainability issues at the board level. The Company continues to strengthen its corporate governance practices and improve its ESG governance structure. As a signatory member of the UNGC, ANTA Sports adheres to the principle of "Value Creation Through Mutualism", leading the industry, business partners and consumers towards a sustainable future through the core values of "Mutualism with Consumers", "Mutualism with Partners", "Mutualism with Employees", "Mutualism with the Society", and "Mutualism with the Environment". 

The "Forward Faster" initiative of the United Nations Global Compact focuses on five major areas: Gender Equality, Climate Action, Living Wages, Water Resilience, and Finance & Investment. The initiative expedites the progress and commitment of businesses towards achieving the sustainable development goals. The "Forward Faster" initiative also aims to increase accountability and transparency by calling for companies to publicly declare their commitments and highlight the actions they will undertake to meet the targets. Companies committing to the targets will be required to report on progress annually to the United Nations Global Compact.

–End–

About the United Nations Global Compact 
United Nations Global Compact aims to accelerate and scale the global collective impact of business by upholding the Ten Principles and delivering the SDGs through accountable companies and ecosystems that enable change. To make this happen, the UNGC supports companies to do business responsibly by aligning their strategies and operations with Ten Principles on human rights, labor, environment and anti-corruption; and take strategic actions to advance broader societal goals, such as the UN Sustainable Development Goals, with an emphasis on collaboration and innovation.

About ANTA Sports
ANTA was established in 1991, while ANTA Sports Products Limited, a widely recognized global sportswear company, was listed on the Main Board of HKEX in 2007 (Stock code: 2020.HK). For many years, ANTA Sports has been principally engaging in the design, R&D, manufacturing, marketing and sales of professional sports products including shoes, apparel and accessories to Chinese consumers. By embracing an all-round brand portfolio including ANTA, FILA, DESCENTE and KOLON SPORT, and by setting up an investor consortium to successfully acquire Amer Sports in 2019, a global sportswear group that has internationally recognized brands including Arc'teryx, Salomon, Wilson, Peak Performance, and Atomic, amongst others. ANTA Sports aims to unlock the potential of both the mass and high-end sportswear markets.

body.tc:
堅定「1+3+5」戰略目標 銳意成為世界領先可持續企業

（二零二三年十月二十日─中國香港）安踏體育用品有限公司（「安踏體育」或「本公司」；股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台）；及其附屬公司統稱「本集團」）今日應邀出席聯合國全球契約組織（UNGC）「加速前進」倡議活動，成為第一批中國企業加入聯合國「加速前進」倡議，我們率先在氣候行動作出承諾，並且是唯一的紡織及服裝公司參加此倡議。在會議上，安踏體育服配採購副總裁林澤強透過可持續包裝、節能减排、企業管治等方面向世界展示安踏體育在可持續發展領域的戰略目標及杰出成就。  

集團服配採購副總裁林澤強（左二）與一眾參與企業及聯合國全球契約組織代表合影

安踏集團服配採購副總裁林澤強於會議上表示：「安踏體育一直堅守對可持續發展的承諾，矢志成為世界領先的可持續標桿企業。集團早已制定了『1+3+5』的可持續戰略目標，承諾到二零五零年在集團層面實現碳中和。安踏體育又在二零二三年一月正式加入並承諾支持科學碳目標倡議(SBTi)，為業務擬定全產業鏈週期的減碳目標。作為最早加入聯合國全球契約組織『加速前進倡議』的中國企業之一，安踏體育將繼續發揮行業引領作用，通過創新和合作，積極推動整個行業產業鏈的可持續發展，力爭在可持續發展的願景上實現更大突破。」

提高環保材料使用佔比  引領可持續消費
安踏體育積極透過研發以及技術創新，不斷提高環保材料在產品和包裝中的使用佔比。集團旗下FILA品牌50%以上的鞋類產品已使用可持續包裝，而旗下DESCENTE品牌鞋的包裝紙及鞋頭紙分別獲得森林管理委員會（FSC）和全球回收標準（GRS）認證。集團的目標是到二零三零年有50%的產品貫徹可持續發展理念，使用可持續包裝和可持續原材料。

從上而下提升管治水平
在公司管治方面，安踏體育成立可持續發展委員會，實現從董事會層面參與可持續發展事務，並不斷加強公司管治水平，完善集團的ESG管治架構。作為聯合國全球契約的簽署成員，集團秉持「創造共生價值」的理念，引領行業、合作夥伴和消費者邁向可持續的未來，並建立「與消費者共生、與夥伴共生、與員工共生、與社會共生、與環境共生」的核心價值觀。

聯合國全球契約組織的「加速前進」倡議聚焦性別平等、氣候行動、生活工資、水資源復原力以及永續投融資五大範疇，旨在加快企業達成可持續發展目標的步伐與投入。該倡議呼籲企業作出公開承諾及提高可持續發展行動的問責性和透明度，並要求企業每年向聯合國全球契約組織報告進展。

–完–

關於聯合國全球契約組織
聯合國全球契約組織致力於在全球範圍內動員可持續發展的企業和利益相關方，創造一個我們想要的世界。為了實現這一目標，聯合國全球契約組織幫助企業將有關人權、勞工、環境和反腐敗的全球契約十項原則納入企業策略和營運中，確保負責任地開展業務。同時，亦以合作和創新為重點，採取策略行動推動更廣泛的社會目標的實現，例如聯合國可持續發展目標。

關於安踏體育用品有限公司
安踏始創於一九九一年，而安踏體育用品有限公司（股份代號：2020（港幣櫃台）及82020（人民幣櫃台））在二零零七年於香港交易所主板上市，是著名的全球體育用品公司。多年來，安踏體育主要從事設計、研發、製造、營銷和銷售體育用品，向中國消費者提供專業的體育用品，包括運動鞋、服裝及配飾。透過多元化的品牌組合，包括安踏、FILA、DESCENTE及KOLON SPORT，以及組成投資者財團於二零一九年成功收購國際運動品牌集團Amer Sports，擁有國際認可品牌包括Arc’teryx、Salomon、Wilson、Peak Performance、Atomic等。安踏體育旨在發掘大眾及高端體育用品市場的潛力。
